original: etādṛśaṃ tattvajñānaṃ vaiśeṣikaśāstrādhīnamiti tasyāpi niḥśreyasahetutvaṃ daṇḍāpūpāyitam| tattvaṃ jñāyate'neneti karaṇavyutpattyā śāstraparatve dharmaviśeṣaprasūtādityanenānanvayāpatteḥ| sarvapadārthapradhāno dvandvaścātra samāsaḥ sarvapadārthatattvajñānasya niḥśrayasahetutvāt|
analyzed: etādṛśam tattva jñānam vaiśeṣika śāstra adhīnam iti tasya api niḥśreyasa hetu tvam daṇḍāpūpāyitam tattvam jñāyate enena iti karaṇa vyutpattyā śāstra paratve dharma viśeṣa prasūtāt iti anena ananvaya āpatteḥ sarva padārtha pradhānaḥ dvandvaḥ ca atra samāsaḥ sarva padārtha tattva jñānasya niḥśrayasa hetu tvāt

original: tadatra śāstraniḥśreyasayorhetuhetumadbhāvaḥ, śāstratattvajñānayorvyāpāravyāpāribhāvaḥ, niśreyasatattvajñānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, dravyādipadārthaśāstrayoḥ pratipādyapratipādakabhāvaḥ sambandho'vagamyate| eteṣāñcasambandhānāṃ jñānānniḥśreyasārthināmiha śāstre pravṛttiḥ mokṣamāṇāśca munergṛhītāptabhāvā eva śāstre pravarttante|
analyzed: tat atra śāstra niḥśreyasayoḥ hetu hetumat bhāvaḥ śāstra tattva jñānayoḥ vyāpāra vyāpāri bhāvaḥ niśreyasa tattva jñānayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ dravya ādi padārtha śāstrayoḥ pratipādya pratipādaka bhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ uvagamyate eteṣām ca sambandhānām jñānāt niḥśreyasa arthinām iha śāstre pravṛttiḥ mokṣamāṇāḥ ca muneḥ gṛhīta āpta bhāvāḥ eva śāstre pravarttante

original: niḥśreyasamātyantikī duḥkhanivṛttiḥ| duḥkhanivṛtteścātyantikatvaṃ samānādhikaraṇaduḥkhaprāgabhāvāsamānakālonatvaṃ yugapadutpannasamānādhikaraṇasarvātmaviśeṣaguṇadhvaṃsasamānakālīnatvaṃ vā| aśeṣaviśeṣaguṇadhvaṃsāvadhikaduḥkhaprāgabhāvo vā muktiḥ| na cāsādhyatvānnāyaṃ puruṣārthaḥ kāraṇavighaṭanamukhena prāgabhāvasyāpi sādhyatvāt|
analyzed: niḥśreyasam ātyantikī duḥkha nivṛttiḥ duḥkha nivṛtteḥ ca ātyantika tvam samāna adhikaraṇa duḥkha prāgabhāva asamāna kālona tvam yugapad utpanna samāna adhikaraṇa sarva ātma viśeṣa guṇa dhvaṃsa samāna kālīna tvam vā aśeṣa viśeṣa guṇa dhvaṃsa avadhika duḥkha prāgabhāvaḥ vā muktiḥ na ca asādhya tvāt na ayam puruṣa arthaḥ kāraṇa vighaṭana mukhena prāgabhāvasya api sādhya tvāt

original: na ca tasya prāgabhāvatvakṣatiḥ pratiyogijanakābhāvatvena tathātvāt| janakatvañca svarūpayogyatā mātram, nahi prāgabhāvaścaramasāmagro yena tasmin sati kāryyamavaśyambhavet tathā sati kāryasyāpyanāditvaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: na ca tasya prāgabhāva tva kṣatiḥ pratiyogi janaka abhāva tvena tathātvāt janaka tvam ca svarūpa yogyatā mātram nahi prāgabhāvaḥ carama sāmagraḥ yena tasmin sati kāryyam avaśyam bhavet tathā sati kāryasya api anādi tva prasaṅgāt

original: tathā ca yathā sahakārivirahādiyantaṃ kālaṃ nājījanat tathāgre'pi tadvirahānna janayiṣyati, detūcchede puruṣavyāpārāt' ityasyāpi prāgabhāvaparipālana eva tātparyāt|
analyzed: tathā ca yathā sahakāri virahāt iyantam kālam na ajījanat tathā agre pi tad virahāt na janayiṣyati detu ucchede puruṣa vyāpārāt iti asya api prāgabhāva paripālane eva tātparyāt

original: ata eva gautamīyadvitīyasūtre "duḥkha janmapravṛttidoṣamithyājñānānāmuttarottarāpāye tadanantarāpāyādapavargaḥ ityatra kāraṇābhāvāt kāryyābhāvābhidhānaṃ duḥkhaprāgabhāvarūpāmeva muktiṃ draḍhayati| nahi doṣāpāye pravṛttyapāyaḥ, pravṛttyapāye janmāpāyaḥ, janmāpāye duḥkhāpāya ityapāyo dhvaṃsaḥ, kintvanutpattiḥ| sā prāgabhāva eva|
analyzed: atas eva gautamīya dvitīya sūtre duḥkha janma pravṛtti doṣa mithyājñānānām uttarottara apāye tad anantara apāyāt apavargaḥ iti atra kāraṇa abhāvāt kāryya abhāva abhidhānam duḥkha prāgabhāva rūpām eva muktim draḍhayati nahi doṣa apāye pravṛtti apāyaḥ pravṛtti apāye janma apāyaḥ janma apāye duḥkha apāyaḥ iti apāyaḥ dhvaṃsaḥ kintu anutpattiḥ sā prāgabhāvaḥ eva

original: naca pratiyogyaprasiddhiḥ sāmānyato duḥkhatvenaiva pratiyogiprasiddheḥ prāyaścittavat, tatrāpi pratyavāyadhvaṃsadvārā duḥkhānutpatterevāpekṣitatvāt loke'pyahikaṇḍakādinivṛtterduḥkhānutpattiphalakatvadarśanāt duḥkhasādhananivṛttyarthameva prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttiḥ|
analyzed: naca pratiyogi aprasiddhiḥ sāmānyatas duḥkha tvena eva pratiyogi prasiddheḥ prāyaścitta vat tatra api pratyavāya dhvaṃsa dvārā duḥkha anutpatteḥ eva apekṣita tvāt loke pi ahi kaṇḍaka ādi nivṛtteḥ duḥkha anutpatti phalaka tva darśanāt duḥkha sādhana nivṛtti artham eva prekṣāvatām pravṛttiḥ

original: kecitta duḥkhātyantābhāva eva muktiḥ| sa ca yadyapi nātmaniṣṭhastathāpi loṣṭādiniṣṭha evātmani sādhyate| siddhiśca tasya duḥkhaprāgabhāvāsahavartiduḥkhadhvaṃsa eva tasya tatsambandhatayopagamāt, tasmin sati tatra duḥkhātyantābhāvapratīteḥ| evañca sati "duḥkhenātyantaṃ vimuktaścarati" ityādiśrutirapyupapāditā bhavatotyāhuḥ|
analyzed: duḥkha atyanta abhāvaḥ eva muktiḥ sa ca yadi api na ātma niṣṭhaḥ tathā api loṣṭa ādi niṣṭhaḥ eva ātmani sādhyate siddhiḥ ca tasya duḥkha prāgabhāva asahavarti duḥkha dhvaṃsaḥ eva tasya tad sambandha tayā upagamāt tasmin sati tatra duḥkha atyanta abhāva pratīteḥ evañca sati duḥkhena atyantam vimuktaḥ carati ityādi śrutiḥ api upapāditā bhavatā iti āhuḥ

original: tanna duḥkhatyantābhāvasyāsādhyatvenāpuruṣārthatvāt| duḥkhadhvaṃsasya ca na tatra sambandhatvaṃ paribhāṣāpatteḥ "duḥkhenātyantaṃ vimuktaścarati" iti śruterduḥkhaprāgabhāvasyaiva kāraṇavighaṭanamukhenātyantābhāvasamānarūpatvatātparyakatvāt|
analyzed: tat na duḥkha atyanta abhāvasya asādhya tvena apuruṣa artha tvāt duḥkha dhvaṃsasya ca na tatra sambandha tvam paribhāṣā āpatteḥ duḥkhena atyantam vimuktaḥ carati iti śruteḥ duḥkha prāgabhāvasya eva kāraṇa vighaṭana mukhena atyanta abhāva samāna rūpatva tātparyaka tvāt

original: nanvayaṃ na puruṣārthaḥ nirupādhīcchāviṣayatvābhāvāt duḥkhakāle sukhaṃ tāvannotpadyate iti sukhārthināmeva duḥkhābhāvārthaṃ pravṛtteriti cenna vaiparītyasyāpi suvacatvāt sukhecchāpi duḥkhābhāvaupādhikītyeva kiṃ na syāt, śokākulānāṃ sukhavimukhānāmapi duḥkhābhāvamātramabhisandhāya viṣabhakṣaṇodbandhanādau pravṛttidarśanāt|
analyzed: nanu ayam na puruṣa arthaḥ nirupādhi icchā viṣaya tva abhāvāt duḥkha kāle sukham tāvat na utpadyate iti sukha arthinām eva duḥkha abhāva artham pravṛtteḥ iti ced na vaiparītyasya api suvaca tvāt sukha icchā api duḥkha abhāva aupādhikī iti eva kim na syāt śoka ākulānām sukha vimukhānām api duḥkha abhāva mātram abhisandhāya viṣa bhakṣaṇa udbandhana ādau pravṛtti darśanāt

original: nanu puruṣārtho'pyayaṃ jñāyamāna eva muktestu duḥkhābhāvasya jñāyamānataiva nāsti anyathā mūrcchādyavasthārthamapi pravartteti cenna śrutyanumānābhyāṃ jñāyamānasyāvedyatvānupapatteḥ| asti hi śrutiḥ "duḥkhenātyantaṃ vimuktaścarati" "tameva viditvā'timṛtyumeti" ityādikā|
analyzed: nanu puruṣa arthaḥ upi ayam jñāyamānaḥ eva mukteḥ tu duḥkha abhāvasya jñāyamāna tā eva nā asti anyathā mūrcchā ādi avasthā artham api pravarttā iti ced na śruti anumānābhyām jñāyamānasya avedya tva anupapatteḥ asti hi śrutiḥ duḥkhena atyantam vimuktaḥ carati tam eva viditvā atimṛtyum eti iti ādikā

original: anumānamapyasti -- duḥkhasantatiratyantamucchidyate santatitvāt pradopasantativadityādi| caramaduḥkhadhvaṃsasya duḥkhasākṣātkāreṇa kṣaṇaṃ viṣayokaraṇāt pratyakṣavedyatā'pi| yogināṃ yogajadharmabalenāgāmino duḥkhadhvaṃsasya pratyakṣopagamācca|
analyzed: anumānam api asti duḥkha santatiḥ atyantam ucchidyate santati tvāt prada upa santati vat ityādi carama duḥkha dhvaṃsasya duḥkha sākṣātkāreṇa kṣaṇam viṣaya ukaraṇāt pratyakṣa vedya tā api yoginām yoga ja dharma balena āgāminaḥ duḥkha dhvaṃsasya pratyakṣa upagamāt ca

original: tathāpi tulyāyavyayatayā nāyaṃ puruṣārthāṃ duḥkhavat sukhasyāpi hāneḥ dvayorapi samānasāmagrīkatvāditi cet utsargato votarāgāṇāṃ duḥkhadurdinabhīrūṇāṃ sukhakhadyotikāmātre'lampratyayavatāṃ tatra pravṛtteḥ|
analyzed: tathā api tulya āya vyaya tayā na ayam duḥkha vat sukhasya api hāneḥ dvayoḥ api samāna sāmagrīka tvāt iti ced utsargataḥ duḥkha durdina bhīrūṇām tatra pravṛtteḥ

original: nanu tathāpi duḥkhanivṛttirna puruṣārthaḥ anāgataduḥkhanivṛtteraśakyatvāt atotaduḥkhasyātītatvāt varttamānaduḥkhasya puruṣaprayatnamantareṇaiva nivṛtteriti cenna hetūcchede puruṣavyāpārāt prāyaścittavat|
analyzed: nanu tathā api duḥkha nivṛttiḥ na puruṣa arthaḥ anāgata duḥkha nivṛtteḥ aśakya tvāt varttamāna duḥkhasya puruṣa prayatnam antareṇa eva nivṛtteḥ iti ced na hetu ucchede puruṣa vyāpārāt prāyaścitta vat

original: tathāhi savāsanaṃ mithyājñānaṃ saṃsārahetustaducchedaścātmatattvajñānāt tattvajñānāt tattvajñānañca yogavidhisādhyamiti tadarthaṃ pravṛttyupapatteḥ|
analyzed: tathā hi sa vāsanam mithyājñānam saṃsāra hetuḥ tad ucchedaḥ ca ātma tattva jñānāt tattva jñānāt tattva jñānañca yoga vidhi sādhyam iti tad artham pravṛtti upapatteḥ

original: nanu nityasukhābhivyaktireva muktirnatu duḥkhābhāva iti cenna nityasukhe pramāṇābhāvāt, bhāve vā nityaṃ tadabhivyaktermuktasaṃsāriṇoraviśeṣāpātāt abivyakterutpādyatvena tannivṛttau punaḥ saṃsārāpatteśca|
analyzed: nanu nitya sukha abhivyaktiḥ eva muktiḥ na tu duḥkha abhāvaḥ iti ced na nitya sukhe pramāṇa abhāvāt bhāve vā nityam tad abhivyakteḥ mukta saṃsāriṇoḥ aviśeṣa āpātāt a bivyakteḥ utpādya tvena tad nivṛttau punar saṃsāra āpatteḥ ca

original: brahmātmani jovātmalayo muktiriti cenna layo yadyekobhāvastadā bādhāt nahi dvayamekaṃ bhavati| liṅgaśarīrāpagamo layo liṅgañcaikādaśendriyāṇi teṣāṃ śarorasya ca vigamo laya iti cenna etāvatā duḥkhasāmagrīvirahasyoktatvāt tathāca duḥkhābhāva eva muktiriti paryavasānāt|
analyzed: brahma ātmani muktiḥ iti ced na layaḥ yadi ekaḥ bhāvaḥ tadā bādhāt nahi dvayam ekam bhavati liṅga śarīra apagamaḥ layaḥ liṅgam ca ekādaśa indriyāṇi teṣām ca vigamaḥ layaḥ iti ced na etāvatā duḥkha sāmagrī virahasya ukta tvāt tathā ca duḥkha abhāvaḥ eva muktiḥ iti paryavasānāt

original: etenāvidyānivṛttau kevalātmasthitirmuktiḥ ātmā ca vijñānasukhātmaka ityekadaṇḍimatamapāstam| ātmano jñānatve sukhatve ca pramāṇābhāvāt| na ca "nityaṃ vijñānamānandaṃ brahma" iti śrutirmānam tasyā jñānavattvānandavattvapratipādakatvāt bhavati hi ahaṃ jāne ahaṃ sukhītipratītiḥ natvahaṃ jñānam ahaṃ sukhamiti|
analyzed: etena avidyā nivṛttau kevala ātma sthitiḥ muktiḥ ātmā ca vijñāna sukha ātmakaḥ iti ekadaṇḍi matam apāstam ātmanaḥ jñāna tve sukha tve ca pramāṇa abhāvāt na ca nityam vijñānam ānandam brahma iti śrutiḥ mānam tasyāḥ jñānavat tva ānandavat tva pratipādaka tvāt bhavati hi aham jāne aham sukhī iti pratītiḥ na tu aham jñānam aham sukham iti

original: kiñca brahmaṇa idānomapi sattvāt muktasaṃsāriṇoraviśeṣāpattiḥ avidyānivṛtteścāpuruṣārthatvāt brahmaṇaśca nityatvenāsādhyatvāt, tatsākṣātkārasya tadātmakatvenāsādhyatvāt, evamānandasyāpi tadātmakatvenāsādhyatvameveti tadarthaṃ pravṛttyanupapattireva|
analyzed: kiñca brahmaṇaḥ idānom api sattvāt mukta saṃsāriṇoḥ aviśeṣa āpattiḥ avidyā nivṛtteḥ ca apuruṣa artha tvāt brahmaṇaḥ ca nitya tvena asādhya tvāt tad sākṣātkārasya tad ātmaka tvena asādhya tvāt evam ānandasya api tad ātmaka tvena asādhya tvam eva iti tad artham pravṛtti anupapattiḥ eva

original: nirupaplavā citsamtatirmuktiriti cenna| duḥkhādirūpasya upaplavasya vigamo yadiḥ nirupalpavatvam tadā tanmātrasyaiva puruṣārthatvena citsantateranuvṛttau pramāṇābhāvaḥ tadanuvṛtterapi śarīrānuvṛtterāvaśyakatvāditi siddhaṃ duḥkhanivṛttirevoktarūpā niḥśreyasamiti|
analyzed: nirupaplavā cit samtatiḥ muktiḥ iti ced na duḥkha ādi rūpasya upaplavasya vigamaḥ nirupalpavatvam tadā tanmātrasya eva puruṣa artha tvena cit santateḥ anuvṛttau pramāṇa abhāvaḥ tad anuvṛtteḥ api śarīra anuvṛtteḥ āvaśyaka tvāt iti siddham duḥkha nivṛttiḥ eva ukta rūpā niḥśreyasam iti

original: tattvasya jñānamiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| sādharmyavaidharmyābhyāmiti prakāre tṛtīyā| tatra sādharmyamanugato dharmaḥ, vaidharmyañca vyāvṛtto dharmaḥ| yadyapi kvacit sādharmyamapi kutaścidvaidharmyaṃ kutaścidvaidhammapi keṣāñcit sādharmyam tathāpi tādrūpyeṇa jñānaṃ vivakṣitam| atra ca dravyādipadārthānāmuddeśa eva vibhāgaḥ paryavasannaḥ|
analyzed: tattvasya jñānam iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām iti prakāre tṛtīyā tatra sādharmyam anugataḥ dharmaḥ vaidharmyam ca vyāvṛttaḥ dharmaḥ yadi api kvacid sādharmyam api kutaścid vaidharmyam kutaścid vaidham api keṣāñcid sādharmyam tathā api tādrūpyeṇa jñānam vivakṣitam atra ca dravya ādi padārthānām uddeśaḥ eva vibhāgaḥ paryavasannaḥ

original: sa ca nyūnādhikasaṅkhyāvyavacchedaphalakastena ṣaḍeva padārthā iti niyamaḥ paryyavasyati, sa cānupapannaḥ vyavacchedyasya padārthāntarasya pratipattau niyamānupapapattiḥ, apratītau vyavacchedānupapattiḥ|
analyzed: sa ca nyūna adhika saṅkhyā vyavaccheda phalakaḥ tena ṣaṭ eva padārthāḥ iti niyamaḥ paryyavasyati sa ca anupapannaḥ vyavacchedyasya padārtha antarasya pratipattau niyama anupapapattiḥ apratītau vyavaccheda anupapattiḥ

original: nanu nāyamanyayogavyavacchedaḥ kintvayogavyavacchedaḥ padārtheṣu ṣaḍ‌lakṣaṇāyogo vyavacchidyata iti cenna padārthapadena prasiddhapadārthamātropasaṃgrahe siddhasādhanāt anaysya cāpratītereva| kiñca lakṣaṇānāṃ militānāmayogo vyavacchedyaḥ pratyekaṃ vā? ādye militāyogaḥ sarvatreti vyavacchedānupapattiḥ|
analyzed: nanu na ayam anya yoga vyavacchedaḥ kintu ayoga vyavacchedaḥ padārtheṣu ṣaṣ lakṣaṇa ayogaḥ vyavacchidyate iti ced na padārtha padena prasiddha padārtha mātra upasaṃgrahe siddhasādhanāt ca apratīteḥ eva kiñca lakṣaṇānām militānām ayogaḥ vyavacchedyaḥ pratyekam vā ādye milita ayogaḥ sarvatra iti vyavaccheda anupapattiḥ

original: antye'pi pratyekāyorāḥ parasparaṃ sarvatreti vyavacchedānupapattireveti cenna| śaktisaṅkhyāsādṛśyādiṣu padārtheṣu parābhimateṣu ṣaḍ‌lakṣaṇāyogaḥ parairucyate tadyavyacchedo niyamārthaḥ, tathāca ṣaḍeva padārthā ityasya pratīyamāneṣu paṇṇāṃ lakṣaṇānāṃ madhye anyatamalakṣaṇayogo'styeva na tvayoga ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: antye api parasparam sarvatra iti vyavaccheda anupapattiḥ eva iti ced na śakti saṅkhyā sādṛśya ādiṣu padārtheṣu para abhimateṣu ṣaṣ lakṣaṇa ayogaḥ paraiḥ ucyate niyama arthaḥ tathāca ṣaṭ eva padārthāḥ iti asya pratīyamāneṣu paṇṇām lakṣaṇānām madhye anyatama lakṣaṇa yogaḥ usti eva na tu ayogaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: rūpamekaṃ kāryamityanvayaḥ| rūpapadamubhayamapi lākṣaṇikam, ajahatsvārthā ceyaṃ lakṣaṇā| kāraṇaikārthasamavāyapratyāsattyā janyajanakabhāvāśrayatvañca śakyalakṣyasādhāraṇo dharmastena rūparasagandhasparśasnehasāṃsiddhikadravatvaikatvaikapṛthak‌tvāni saṃgṛhyante| ete hi kāraṇe varttamānāḥ kāryeṣu samānajātīyamekameva guṇamārabhante|
analyzed: rūpam ekam kāryam iti anvayaḥ rūpa padam ubhayam api lākṣaṇikam ajahatsvārthā ca iyam lakṣaṇā kāraṇa ekārtha samavāya pratyāsattyā janya janaka bhāva āśraya tvam ca śakya lakṣya sādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ tena rūpa rasa gandha sparśa sneha sāṃsiddhika drava tva ekatva ekapṛthaktvāni saṃgṛhyante ete hi kāraṇe varttamānāḥ kāryeṣu samāna jātīyam ekam eva guṇam ārabhante

original: dvidhā hyasamavāyikāraṇānāṅgatiḥ| kecit kāraṇaikārthapratyāsattyā janayanti, kāraṇamiha samavāyikāraṇaṃ tacca janyasya rūpādilakṣaṇasya kāryasya tena rūpādilakṣaṇasya yat samavāyikāraṇaṃ ghaṭādi tena saha kapāle vartamānaṃ rūpaṃ kāraṇaikārthasamavāyena ghaṭarūpamārabhate, evaṃ rasādyapi|
analyzed: dvidhā hi asamavāyi kāraṇa anāṃgatiḥ kecid kāraṇa ekārtha pratyāsattyā janayanti kāraṇam iha samavāyi kāraṇam tat ca janyasya rūpa ādi lakṣaṇasya kāryasya tena rūpa ādi lakṣaṇasya yat samavāyi kāraṇam ghaṭa ādi tena saha kapāle vartamānam rūpam kāraṇa ekārtha samavāyena ghaṭa rūpam ārabhate evam rasa ādi api

original: kvacittu kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇatvam yathā kāraṇamapi śabdo nabhasi kāryamapi śabdāntaramārabhate, nabhasyeva rūpādyapi pārthivaparamāṇāvagnisaṃyogena kāryaikārthasamavāyapratyāsattyā janyate || 28 ||

original: nanu mūrttaguṇānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatvaṃ svāśrayaguṇapūrvakatvañcoktam, dravyakarmaṇośca na karma kāraṇamityuktam tathāca karmaṇaḥ kimapi na kāryyamityāyātam, tathācātondriyāṇāṃ sūryyādigatīnām anumānamapi durlabhaṃ liṅgābhāvāt ataḥ saṃyogāvibhāgavegānāṃ karmeti sūtroktameva smārayannāha --
analyzed: nanu mūrtta guṇānām kāryāṇām kāraṇa guṇa pūrvaka tvam sva āśraya guṇa pūrvaka tvam ca uktam dravya karmaṇoḥ ca na karma kāraṇam iti uktam tathā ca karmaṇaḥ kim api na kāryyam iti āyātam tathā ca atas indriyāṇām sūryya ādi gatīnām anumānam api durlabham liṅga abhāvāt atas saṃyoga avibhāga vegānām karma iti sūtra uktam eva smārayan āha

original: saṃyogavibhāgāśca karmaṇām || 30 ||
analyzed: saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ ca karmaṇām

original: janyā iti śeṣaḥ| vyaktyabhiprāyeṇa bahuvacanaṃ saṃskāro'pyupalakṣaṇīyaḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: janyāḥ iti śeṣaḥ vyakti abhiprāyeṇa bahuvacanam saṃskāraḥ api upalakṣaṇīyaḥ

analyzed: nanu dravya karmaṇī na karma kārye iti pūrvam uktam saṃyoga vibhāgau tu saṃyoga vibhāga kāryyau eva tathā ca idānīm karmaṇaḥ kāraṇa tva abhidhānam viruddham iti atas āha

original: kāraṇasāmānye dravyakarmaṇāṃ karmākāraṇamuktam || 31 ||
analyzed: kāraṇa sāmānye dravya karmaṇām karma akāraṇam uktam

original: kāraṇasāmānyapadena tatprakaraṇamupalakṣyate tena kāraṇasāmānyābhidhānamakaraṇe dravyakarmaṇo prati karmaṇo'kāraṇatvamuktaṃ na tu sarvathāpyakāraṇameva karmeti vivakṣitam| yena `saṃyogavibhāgāśca karmaṇāmiti' sūtraṃ vyāhanyeteti bhāvaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: kāraṇa sāmānya padena tat prakaraṇam upalakṣyate tena kāraṇa sāmānya abhidhāna makaraṇe dravya karmaṇo prati karmaṇaḥ ukāraṇa tvam uktam na tu sarvathā api akāraṇam eva karma iti vivakṣitam yena saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ ca karmaṇām iti sūtram vyāhanyeta iti bhāvaḥ

original: iti śāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre prathamādhyāyasya
analyzed: iti śāṅkare vaiśeṣika sūtra upaskāre prathama adhyāyasya

original: prathamāhnikam|

original: prathamādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam

original: nanvanena praghaṭṭakena dravyādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ padārthānāṃ kāryaikatvaghaṭitaṃ kāraṇaikatvaghaṭitañca sādharmyamuktam, taccānupapannaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasyaivāsiddherityata āha --
analyzed: nanu anena praghaṭṭakena dravya ādīnām trayāṇām padārthānām kārya ekatva ghaṭitam kāraṇa ekatva ghaṭitam ca sādharmyam uktam tat ca anupapannam kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya eva asiddheḥ iti atas āha

original: kāraṇābhāvātkāryābhāvaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ

original: dṛśyate hi mṛccakrasalilakulālasūtrādau samavahite'pi daṇḍābhāvād ghaṭābhāvaḥ, bhūsalilādau samavahite'pi vījābhāvādaṅkarābhāvaḥ, sa ca daṇḍaghaṭayorbījāṅkurayorvā kāryakāraṇabhāvamantareṇānupapannaḥ| anyathā vemādyabhāve'pi ghaṭābhāvaḥ śilāśakalādyabhāve'pyaṅkurābhāvaḥ syāt|
analyzed: dṛśyate hi mṛd cakra salila kulāla sūtra ādau samavahite api daṇḍa abhāvāt ghaṭa abhāvaḥ bhū salila ādau samavahite api vīja abhāvāt aṅkara abhāvaḥ sa ca daṇḍa ghaṭayoḥ bīja aṅkurayoḥ vā kārya kāraṇa bhāvam antareṇa anupapannaḥ anyathā vema ādi abhāve api ghaṭa abhāvaḥ śilā śakala ādi abhāve api aṅkura abhāvaḥ syāt

original: kiñca ghaṭapaṭādīnāṃ kādācitkatvamanubhūyate tadapi hetuphalabhāvamantareṇānupapannam, nahi kiñcitkālāsattve sati kiñcitkālasattvarūpaṃ kādācitkatvaṃ bhāvānāṃ kāraṇāpekṣāmantareṇa sambhavati tadā hi syādeva na syādeva vā natu kadācit syāt na hi bhāvo na bhavatyeva nāpyahetorbhavati nāpyakasmādeva bhavati, na vā nirupākhyādeva śaśaviṣāṇāderbhavati,
analyzed: kiñca ghaṭa paṭa ādīnām kādācitkatvam anubhūyate tat api hetu phala bhāvam antareṇa anupapannam nahi kiñcid kāla asattve sati kiñcid kāla sattva rūpam kādācitkatvam bhāvānām kāraṇa apekṣām antareṇa sambhavati tadā hi syāt eva na syāt eva vā natu kadācid syāt na hi bhāvaḥ na bhavati eva na api ahetoḥ bhavati na api akasmāt eva bhavati na vā nirupākhyāt eva śaśaviṣāṇa ādeḥ bhavati

original: kintu daṇḍavemādeḥ sopākhyasyāvadherghaṭapaṭādau kārye darśanāt avadhistu kāraṇameva| evaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvābhāve pravṛttinivṛttī na syātām tathā ca nirīhaṃ jagajjāyeta na hīṣṭasādhanatājñānamantareṇa pravṛttiraniṣṭasādhanatājñānamantareṇa nivṛttiḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: kintu daṇḍa vema ādeḥ sopākhyasya avadheḥ ghaṭa paṭa ādau kārye darśanāt avadhiḥ tu kāraṇam eva evam kārya kāraṇa bhāva abhāve pravṛtti nivṛttī na syātām tathā ca nirīham jagat jāyeta na hi iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānam antareṇa pravṛttiḥ aniṣṭa sādhana tā jñānam antareṇa nivṛttiḥ

original: nanu sadevotpadyate nāsat "sadeva saumyedamagra āsīt" ityādiśrutiprāmāṇyāt anyathā'sattvāviśeṣe tantubhya eva paṭo na kapālebhya iti niyamo na syāditi cet pariṇāmavādibhirapi svīkṛtakāraṇakairayaṃ niyamo'bhyupagantavya eva, anyathā ghaṭābhivyaktiḥ kapāleṣveva na tantuṣviti kathaṃ syāt|
analyzed: nanu sat eva utpadyate na asat sat eva saumya idam agre āsīt ityādi śruti prāmāṇyāt anyathā sattva aviśeṣe tantubhyaḥ eva paṭaḥ na kapālebhyaḥ iti niyamaḥ na syāt iti ced pariṇāma vādibhiḥ api svīkṛta kāraṇakaiḥ ayam niyamaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ eva anyathā ghaṭa abhivyaktiḥ kapāleṣu eva na tantuṣu iti katham syāt

original: kiñca yadyabhivyaktirapi pūrvamāsīdeva tadā tasyā api nityatve āvirbhāvatirobhāvādhevotpādavināśāviti riktaṃ vacaḥ| athāvirbhāvatirobhāvau kāraṇāpekṣau, tadā ghaṭapaṭādīnāmapi kāraṇāpekṣaivāsatāmapyutpattirityāyātam| yattu kāraṇaṃ prati niyamānupapattirityuktam, tatra svabhāvaniyamenaivottaram|
analyzed: kiñca yadi abhivyaktiḥ api pūrvam āsīt eva tadā tasyāḥ api nitya tve āvirbhāva tirobhāvāt ha iva utpāda vināśau iti riktam vacaḥ atha āvirbhāva tirobhāvau kāraṇa apekṣau tadā ghaṭa paṭa ādīnām api kāraṇa apekṣā eva asatām api utpattiḥ iti āyātam yat tu kāraṇam prati niyama anupapattiḥ iti uktam tatra svabhāva niyamena eva uttaram

original: sa ca svabhāvaniyamo'nvayavyatirekāvagamyo bhavati, bhavati hi daṇḍamantareṇa na ghaṭo daṇ‍ḍe sati ghaṭa iti sarvasākṣiko'nubhavaḥ| evañvānanyathāsiddhaniyatapūrvavarttijātīyatvaṃ sahakārivaikalyaprayuktakāryābhāvavattvaṃ vā kāraṇatvam|
analyzed: sa ca svabhāva niyamaḥ nvaya vyatireka avagamyaḥ bhavati bhavati hi daṇḍam antareṇa na ghaṭaḥ daṇḍe sati ghaṭaḥ iti sarva sākṣikaḥ anubhavaḥ evam vā ananyathāsiddha niyata pūrva vartti jātīya tvam sahakāri vaikalya prayukta kārya abhāvavat tvam vā kāraṇatvam

original: yadyapi "yavairyajeta vrīhibhirvā" ityādau niyatapūrvavarttitvaṃ nāsti na hi yavakaraṇakayāganiṣpādye phale vrīhikaraṇakayāgasya pūrvavarttitvam tathāpi vikalpitaṃ vihitakāraṇaṃ kāraṇameva, phalaikajātye'pi dvayoḥ kāraṇatvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: yadi api yavaiḥ yajeta vrīhibhiḥ vā ityādau niyata pūrvavartti tvam na asti na hi yava karaṇaka yāga niṣpādye phale vrīhi karaṇaka yāgasya pūrvavartti tvam tathā api vikalpitam vihita kāraṇam kāraṇam eva phala eka jātye api dvayoḥ kāraṇa tva upapatteḥ

original: tathā ca sahakārivaikalyaprayuktakāryyābhāvavattvaṃ lokavedasādhāraṇī kāraṇatā, niyatapūrvavarttitvantu anvayavyatirekagamyā kāraṇatā laukikī, nahi "svargakāmo yajeta" ityādau vyatirekabhāgo'pi viṣayaḥ pravṛtteranvayamātrajñānādevopapatteḥ, ata eva "vikalpe ubhayamaśāstrārthaḥ" ityapi ghaṭate, tajjātīyasya phalasya
analyzed: tathā ca sahakāri vaikalya prayukta kāryya abhāvavat tvam loka veda sādhāraṇī kāraṇatā niyata pūrva vartti tvantu anvaya vyatireka gamyā kāraṇatā laukikī nahi svarga kāmaḥ yajeta ityādau vyatireka bhāgaḥ api viṣayaḥ pravṛtteḥ anvaya mātra jñānāt eva upapatteḥ atas eva vikalpe ubhayam aśāstra arthaḥ iti api ghaṭate tad jātīyasya phalasya

original: ekenaivopapatteraparānuṣṭhānavaiyarthyāt| ata eva "śrautāt sāṅgāt karmaṇaḥ phalāvaśyambhāvaniyamaḥ" ityapyucitam "āgamamūlatvāccāsyārthasya vyabhicāro na doṣāya" ityācāryābhidhānamṛjvarthatātparyyakameva| tṛṇāraṇimaṇisthale tu kāryavaijātyamāvaśyakaṃ tatrānvayavyatirekagamyatvāt kāraṇatāyā vyatirekādvyatirekasyāvaśyakatvāt|
analyzed: ekena eva upapatteḥ apara anuṣṭhāna vaiyarthyāt atas eva śrautāt sa aṅgāt karmaṇaḥ phala avaśyambhāva niyamaḥ iti api ucitam āgama mūla tvāt ca asya arthasya vyabhicāraḥ na doṣāya iti ācārya abhidhānam ṛju artha tātparyyakam eva tṛṇa araṇi maṇi sthale tu kārya vaijātyam āvaśyakam tatra anvaya vyatireka gamya tvāt kāraṇatāyāḥ vyatirekāt vyatirekasya āvaśyaka tvāt

original: vikalpasthale tu phalavaijātyakalpane rājasūyavājapeyādāvapi vaikalpiko kāraṇatā syāditi kāryakāraṇabhāvaniyamamevopapādayannāha --
analyzed: vikalpa sthale tu phala vaijātya kalpane rājasūya vājapeya ādau api vaikalpikā kāraṇatā syāt iti kārya kāraṇa bhāva niyamam eva upapādayan āha

original: na tu kāryābhāvāt kāraṇābhāvaḥ || 2 ||

original: yadi kāryakāraṇabhāvaniyamo na bhavati tadā kāryābhāvādapi kāraṇābhāvaḥ syāt| kāryābhāvaḥ kāraṇābhāvaṃ pratyatantraṃ kāraṇābhāvastu kāryābhāvaṃ prati tantram, tena duḥkhābhāvārthaṃ janmābhāve, janmābhāvārthaṃ pravṛttyabhāve, tadarthañca doṣābhāve, tadarthaṃ mithyājñānanivṛttaye, tadarthañcātmasākṣātkārāya mumukṣūṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ
analyzed: yadi kārya kāraṇa bhāva niyamaḥ na bhavati tadā kārya abhāvāt api kāraṇa abhāvaḥ syāt kārya abhāvaḥ kāraṇa abhāvam prati atantram kāraṇa abhāvaḥ tu kārya abhāvam prati tantram tena duḥkha abhāva artham janma abhāve janma abhāva artham pravṛtti abhāve tad artham ca doṣa abhāve tad artham mithyājñāna nivṛttaye tad artham ca ātma sākṣātkārāya mumukṣūṇām pravṛttiḥ

original: prayojanamaupod‌ghātikasyāpyasya dvisūtrakaprakaraṇasya || 2 ||

original: padārthatrayoddeśalakṣaṇānantaramidānīmuddiṣṭasya sāmānyapadārthasya lakṣaṇamāha --

original: sāmānyaṃ dvividhaṃ paramaparañca| tatra paraṃ sattā aparaṃ sattāvyāpyaṃ dravyatvādi| tatra sāmānyasya tadviśeṣasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ buddhireva| anuvṛttabuddhiḥ sāmānyasya vyāvṛttabuddhirviśeṣasya| itinā dvayamavacchidya parāmṛśyate tena buddhyapekṣamiti napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ|
analyzed: sāmānyam dvividham param aparam ca tatra param sattā aparam sattā vyāpyam dravya tva ādi tatra sāmānyasya tad viśeṣasya ca lakṣaṇam buddhiḥ eva anuvṛtta buddhiḥ sāmānyasya vyāvṛtta buddhiḥ viśeṣasya itinā dvayam avacchidya parāmṛśyate tena buddhi apekṣam iti napuṃsaka nirdeśaḥ

original: vṛttikārastu viśeṣānvayamāha parantu "napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām" ityanenaikavadbhāvo napuṃsakatā cetyāha -- buddhirapekṣā liṅgaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vā yasya tad‌buddhyapekṣam| tatra nityamanekavyaktivṛtti māmānyam, nityatve sati svāśrayānyonyābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vā|
analyzed: vṛtti kāraḥ tu viśeṣa anvayam āha parantu napuṃsakam anapuṃsakena eka vat ca asya anyatarasyām iti anena eka vat bhāvaḥ napuṃsaka tā ca iti āha buddhiḥ apekṣā liṅgam lakṣaṇam vā yasya tat buddhi apekṣam tatra nityam aneka vyakti vṛtti māmānyam nitya tve sati sva āśraya anyonya abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇyam vā

original: paramapi sāmānyamaparamapi tathā'parantu sāmānyaṃ viśeṣasaṃjñāmapi labhate yathā dravyamidamityanuvṛttapratyaye satyeva nāyaṃ guṇo nedaṃ karmeti viśeṣapratyayaḥ tathā ca dravyatvādīnaṃ sāmānyānāmeva viśeṣatvam|

original: evaṃ kampo'pi vāyusattve liṅgam tathāhi idaṃ rūpavad‌dravyābhighātamantareṇa tṛṇādau karma sparśavadvegavad dravyābhighātajaṃ gurutvaprayatnavadātmasaṃyogadravatvasaṃskārāṇāmupagrahaḥ tenaṃ tadajanyakarmatvaṃ hetuḥ|
analyzed: evam kampaḥ api vāyu sattve liṅgam tathā hi idam rūpavat dravya abhighātam antareṇa tṛṇa ādau karma sparśavat vegavat dravya abhighāta jam guru tva prayatnavat ātma saṃyoga drava tva saṃskārāṇām upagrahaḥ tena tat ajanya karma tvam hetuḥ

original: nanu pratyakṣa eva vāyuḥ kimatra liṅgagaveṣaṇayeti cenna vāyurna pratyakṣaḥ norūpabahirdravyatvāt gaganavadityanumānādatīndriyatvasyaiva siddheḥ| nanu vāyuḥ pratyakṣaḥ sparśāśrayatvād ghaṭavaditi pratyakṣatvānumānamiti cenna ud‌bhūtarūpavattvasyātropādhitvāt ca|
analyzed: nanu pratyakṣaḥ eva vāyuḥ kim atra liṅga gaveṣaṇayā iti ced na vāyuḥ na pratyakṣaḥ norūpa bahis dravya tvāt gagana vat iti anumānāt atīndriya tvasya eva siddheḥ nanu vāyuḥ pratyakṣaḥ sparśa āśraya tvāt ghaṭa vat iti pratyakṣa tva anumānam iti ced na udbhūta rūpavat tvasya atra upādhi tvāt ca

original: na rūpādāvātmani ca sādyāvyāpakametat, pakṣadharmabahirdravyatvāvacchinnasya sādhanadharmā vacchinnasya vā sādhyasya vyāpakatvāt|
analyzed: na rūpa ādau ātmani ca sādya avyāpakam etat pakṣa dharma bahis dravya tva avacchinnasya sādhana dharma avacchinnasya vā sādhyasya vyāpaka tvāt

original: na ca cākṣuṣapratyakṣatvaṃ tattantraṃ tatraiva tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānāt spārśanapratyakṣatve tu yogyasparśavattāmātrasya tantrateti vācyam rūpānvayavyatirekayorubhayatrāpi tantratvāt, na hyubhayasidsparśenaiva pratyakṣatā rūpasya grahamantareṇa dṛṣṭā| kiñca yadi vāyuḥ pratyakṣaḥ syāt saṅkhyādisāmānyaguṇopalambhe'pi tantraṃ syāt|
analyzed: na ca cākṣuṣa pratyakṣa tvam tat tantram tatra eva tad anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānāt spārśana pratyakṣa tve tu yogya sparśavat tā mātrasya tantra tā iti vācyam rūpa anvaya vyatirekayoḥ ubhayatra api tantra tvāt na hi ubhaya siddh sparśena eva pratyakṣa tā rūpasya graham antareṇa dṛṣṭā kiñca yadi vāyuḥ pratyakṣaḥ syāt saṅkhyā ādi sāmānya guṇa upalambhaḥ api tantram syāt

original: nanvastyeva phūt‌kārādau saṅkhyāyāḥ parimāṇasya ca hastavitastyādeḥ ubhayapārśvavartinorvāyvoḥ pṛthak‌tvasya ca paratvāpaparatvayośca pratyakṣatā vāyujātīyasya vyaktiparatayā tu na tavāpi niyamaḥ pṛṣṭhalagnavastrādau tadanupalambhāditi cenna ñyaktiparatayaiva niyamāt pṛṣṭhalagnavastrādau cārjavāvasthāne saṅkhyādīnāṃ grahaṇāt,
analyzed: nanu asti eva phūtkāra ādau saṅkhyāyāḥ parimāṇasya ca hasta vitasti ādeḥ ubhaya pārśva vartinoḥ vāyvoḥ pṛthaktvasya ca paratva apaparatvayoḥ ca pratyakṣa tā vāyu jātīyasya vyakti para tayā tu na tava api niyamaḥ pṛṣṭha lagna vastra ādau tad anupalambhāt iti ced na niyamāt pṛṣṭha lagna vastra ādau ca ārjava avasthāne saṅkhyā ādīnām grahaṇāt

original: anārjavāvasthānadoṣāttu tadagrahaḥ| ud‌bhūtarūpasparśau militāveva bahirdravyapratyakṣatve tantre prabhāyā nayanagatapītadravyasya candramahasaśca tparśānudbhavādapratyakṣatvam nidāghoṣmaṇorvibhaktāvayavāpyadravyāṇāñca rūpānudbhavādapratyakṣatvamiti nyāyavārttikatātparyyaṭīkākṛtaḥ|
analyzed: anārjava avasthāna doṣāt tu tad agrahaḥ udbhūta rūpa sparśau militau eva bahis dravya pratyakṣa tve tantre prabhāyāḥ nayana gata pīta dravyasya candra mahasaḥ ca tparśa anudbhavāt apratyakṣa tvam nidāgha ūṣmaṇoḥ vibhakta avayava āpya dravyāṇām ca rūpa anudbhavāt apratyakṣa tvam iti nyāyavārttikatātparyyaṭīkā kṛtaḥ

original: sparśānudbhave'pi prabhādīnāṃ pratyakṣataiva ata eva cāndrāloke nabhasi pakṣikāṇḍādisaṃyogavibhāgayoḥ pratyakṣataiveti sampradāyavidaḥ| na cod‌bhūtasparśavattvaṃ sāmānyato bahirdravyapratyakṣatāprayojakamiti vācyam, indranīlaprabhāyā apratyakṣatāpatteḥ| na cod‌būtaviśeṣaguṇavattvameva tantram ākāśasyāpi pratyakṣatāpatteḥ|
analyzed: sparśa anudbhave pi prabhā ādīnām pratyakṣatā eva atas eva cāndrāloke nabhasi pakṣi kāṇḍa ādi saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ pratyakṣatā eva iti sampradāya vidaḥ na ca udbhūta sparśavat tvam sāmānyatas bahis dravya pratyakṣatā prayojakam iti vācyam indranīla prabhāyāḥ apratyakṣatā āpatteḥ na ca udbūta viśeṣa guṇavat tvam eva tantram ākāśasya api pratyakṣatā āpatteḥ

original: na ca janyamahattva samānādhikaraṇod‌bhūtaviśeṣaguṇavattvaṃ tathā rasanāgravarttipittadravyasya taiktyodbhave'pyapratyakṣatvāt, tasmādudbhūtarūpavattvamevātmetaradravyapratyakṣatātantram tacca vāyau nāstītyapratyakṣo vāyuḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: na ca janya mahat tva samāna adhikaraṇa udbhūta viśeṣa guṇavat tvam tathā rasanā agravartti pitta dravyasya taiktya udbhave pi apratyakṣa tvāt tasmāt udbhūta rūpavat tvam eva ātma itara dravya pratyakṣatā tantram tat ca vāyau na asti iti apratyakṣaḥ vāyuḥ

original: nanu pratyakṣato dṛṣṭamiha liṅgaṃ nāsti na hi vahnidhūmayoriveha pratyakṣeṇa vyāptigrahaḥ| kiñca pṛthivyādyanyatamasyeva sparśo'pyayaṃ bhaviṣyatītyata āha --
analyzed: nanu pratyakṣataḥ dṛṣṭam iha liṅgam nā asti na hi vahni dhūmayoḥ iva iha pratyakṣeṇa vyāpti grahaḥ kiñca pṛthivī ādi anyatamasya iva sparśaḥ api ayam bhaviṣyati iti atas āha

original: na ca dṛṣṭānāṃ sparśa ityadṛṣṭaliṅgo vāyuḥ || 10 ||

original: ayaṃ sparśo yaḥ pakṣaḥ kriyate sa dṛṣṭānāṃ pṛthivyaptejasāṃ na bhavati rūpāsahacaratvāt, tathā cāyaṃsparśaḥ kvicidāśrita ityanumeyamityadṛṣṭaliṅgaḥ| sāmānyatodṛṣṭaliṅgo'pi pakṣadharmatābalādāyāta ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ayam sparśaḥ yaḥ pakṣaḥ kriyate sa dṛṣṭānām pṛthivī ap tejasām na bhavati rūpa asahacara tvāt tathā ca ayam sparśaḥ kvicid āśritaḥ iti anumeyam iti adṛṣṭa liṅgaḥ sāmānyatodṛṣṭa liṅgaḥ upi pakṣa dharmatā balāt āyātaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yadyapi dṛṣṭameva sparśādicatuṣkaṃ liṅgamiti tathāpi vāyunā sahāgṛhītavyāptikatvādadṛṣṭaliṅgatvamuktam na hyayaṃ dharmī vāyuriti pratijñāya vāyuḥ sādhayituṃ śakyate, tathāca sāmānyatodṛṣṭādevetaravāsahakṛtādvāyusiddhiriti bhāvaḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: yadi api dṛṣṭam eva sparśa ādi catuṣkam liṅgam iti tathā api vāyunā saha agṛhīta vyāptika tvāt adṛṣṭa liṅga tvam uktam na hi ayam dharmī vāyuḥ iti pratijñāya vāyuḥ sādhayitum śakyate tathāca sāmānyatodṛṣṭāt eva itara vā sahakṛtāt vāyu siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: upalabhyamānasparśāśrayamavayavinaṃ sādhayitvā paramāṇulakṣaṇaṃ vāyuṃ sādhayitumāha --
analyzed: upalabhyamāna sparśa āśrayam avayavinam sādhayitvā paramāṇu lakṣaṇam vāyum sādhayitum āha

analyzed: adravyavat tvena dravyam

original: dravyamāśrayabhūtamasyāstīti dravyavat na dravyavat adravyavat dravyānāśritamityarthaḥ| tathā cākāśavat paramāṇulakṣaṇo vāyurdravyam anyeṣāṃ padārthānāṃ dravyāśritatvāt| āśritatvañcānyatra nityadravyebhya ityabhidhānāt paramāṇubhyāṃ dvyaṇukārambhāt dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇāvayavino mahata ārambhasyopapādanīyatvāditi || 11 ||
analyzed: dravyam āśraya bhūtam asya asti iti dravyavat na dravyavat adravyavat dravya anāśritam iti arthaḥ tathā ca ākāśa vat paramāṇu lakṣaṇaḥ vāyuḥ dravyam anyeṣām padārthānām dravya āśrita tvāt āśrita tvam ca anyatra nitya dravyebhyaḥ iti abhidhānāt paramāṇubhyām dvi aṇuka ārambhāt dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa avayavinaḥ mahataḥ ārambhasya upapādanīya tvāt iti

original: vāyuparamāṇordravyatvasādhakaṃ hetudvayaṃ samuccinvannāha --
analyzed: vāyu paramāṇoḥ dravya tva sādhakam hetu dvayam samuccinvan āha

original: kriyāvattvād guṇavattvācca || 12 ||
analyzed: kriyāvat tvāt guṇavat tvāt ca

original: vāyuparamāṇurdravyamiti śeṣaḥ| yadyapi dravyatve siddhe krivāvattvaṃ guṇavattvañca sidhyati tat‌siddhau ca dravyatvasiddhirityanyonyāśrayaḥ tathāpyupalabhyamānasparśāśrayasyāvayavino mūlabhūtasya paramāṇorasamavāyikāraṇasaṃyogānyathānupapattyā kriyāvattvam, avayavisparśarūpādeḥ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatvaniyamād guṇavattvañca siddhaṃ
analyzed: vāyu paramāṇuḥ dravyam iti śeṣaḥ yadi api dravya tve siddhe krivāvat tvam guṇavat tvañca sidhyati tad siddhau ca dravya tva siddhiḥ iti anyonya āśrayaḥ tathā api upalabhyamāna sparśa āśrayasya avayavinaḥ mūla bhūtasya paramāṇoḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa saṃyoga anyathā anupapattyā kriyāvat tvam avayavi sparśa rūpa ādeḥ kāraṇa guṇa pūrvakatva niyamāt guṇavat tvañca siddham

original: tābhyāñcadravyatvamityadoṣaḥ| tatra kriyāvattvaṃ sapakṣaikadeśavṛttiguṇavattvañca sapakṣavyāpakam| cakārāt samavāyikāraṇatvaṃ dravyatvasādhakaṃ samuccinoti| nanu paramāṇāveva na pramāṇaṃ kasya dravyatvaṃ sādhyata iti cenna sthūlakāryyasya kriyāvibhāgādinyāyena bhajyamānasyālpataratamādibhāvāt yato nālpīyaḥ sa eva paramāṇuḥ|
analyzed: tābhyām ca dravya tvam iti adoṣaḥ tatra kriyāvat tvam sapakṣa eka deśa vṛtti guṇavat tvam ca sapakṣa vyāpakam cakārāt samavāyikāraṇa tvam dravya tva sādhakam samuccinoti nanu paramāṇau eva na pramāṇam kasya dravya tvam sādhyate iti ced na sthūla kāryyasya kriyā vibhāga ādi nyāyena bhajyamānasya alpataratama ādi bhāvāt yatas na alpīyaḥ saḥ eva paramāṇuḥ

original: avayavāvayaviprasaṅgasyānavadhitve anantāvayavatvāviśeṣe sumerusarṣapādīnāṃ parimāṇāviśeṣāpattiḥ kāraṇasaṃyakhyāviśeṣamantareṇa parimāṇāpracayayorapi parimāṇabhedaṃ pratyatantratvāt| na ca vināśāvadhirevāyam avayavāvayaviprasaṅgaḥ antyasya niravayavatvena vināśānupapatteḥ sāvayavatve ca niravadhitvāpattestatra ca doṣasyoktatvāt|
analyzed: avayava avayavi prasaṅgasya anavadhi tve ananta avayava tva aviśeṣe sumeru sarṣapa ādīnām parimāṇa aviśeṣa āpattiḥ kāraṇa saṃyakhyā viśeṣam antareṇa parimāṇa apracayayoḥ api parimāṇa bhedam prati atantra tvāt na ca vināśa avadhiḥ eva ayam avayava avayavi prasaṅgaḥ antyasya niravayava tvena vināśa anupapatteḥ sāvayava tve ca niravadhi tva āpattyāḥ tatra ca doṣasya ukta tvāt

original: nanu truṭirevāvadhirdṛśyamānatvādadṛśyamānakalpanāyāṃ mānābhāvāditi cenna tasya cākṣuṣadravyatvayorāvaśyakatvāt tasmāt trasareṇvavayavāvayava eva paramāṇuryathā pṛthivyādau tathā vāyāvapīti siddho vāyuparamāṇuḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: nanu truṭiḥ eva avadhiḥ dṛśyamāna tvāt adṛśyamāna kalpanāyām māna abhāvāt iti ced na tasya cākṣuṣa dravya tvayoḥ āvaśyaka tvāt tasmāt trasareṇu avayava avayavaḥ eva paramāṇuḥ yathā pṛthivī ādau tathā vāyau api iti siddhaḥ vāyu paramāṇuḥ 12

original: nanu kriyāvattvād guṇavattvācca ghaṭādivat paramāṇoranityatvamanumeyamata āha --
analyzed: nanu kriyāvat tvāt guṇavat tvāt ca ghaṭa ādi vat paramāṇoḥ anitya tvam anumeyam atas āha

analyzed: adravya tvena nitya tvam uktam

original: paramāṇulakṣaṇavāyoriti śeṣaḥ| dravyaṃ hi samāvāyikāraṇāsamavāyikāraṇānyataranāśānnaśyati paramāṇostu niravayavatayā na tadubhayamasti tathāca vināśakābhāvānna vinaśyati| kriyāvattve guṇavattve ca hetau sāvayavatvamupādhiḥ| sa ca pakṣadharmadravyatvāvacchinnasādhyavyāpakaḥ kevalasādhyavyāpakastu prāgabhāvapratiyogitvamupādhiḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: paramāṇu lakṣaṇa vāyoḥ iti śeṣaḥ dravyam hi samāvāyi kāraṇa asamavāyi kāraṇa anyatara nāśāt naśyati paramāṇoḥ tu niravayava tayā na tat ubhayam asti tathāca vināśaka abhāvāt na vinaśyati kriyāvat tve guṇavat tve ca hetau sāvayavatvam upādhiḥ sa ca pakṣa dharma dravya tva avacchinna sādhya vyāpakaḥ kevala sādhya vyāpakaḥ tu prāgabhāva pratiyogitvam upādhiḥ

original: dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇārambhasiddhau siddhamapi vāyunānātvaṃ prakārāntareṇāpi sādhayitumāha --
analyzed: dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa ārambha siddhau siddham api vāyu nānātvam prakāra antareṇa api sādhayitum āha

original: vāyorvāyusaṃmūrcchanaṃ nānātvaliṅgam || 14 ||

original: vāyusaṃmūrcchanamiti| vāyvorvāyūnāṃ vā saṃmūrcchanaṃ saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ| sa ca samānavegayorviruddhadik‌kriyayoḥ sannipātaḥ| sa ca tṛṇatūlakāderūrdhvagamanenānumīyate| vāyvorūrdhvagamanasya sannipātasya cātīndriyatvāt| tṛṇādīnāntu pratyakṣāṇāmūrdhvagamanalakṣaṇāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratyakṣāyāḥ sparśavadvegavad‌dravyābhighātanodanānyatarajanyatvamanumīyate|
analyzed: vāyu saṃmūrcchanam iti vāyvoḥ vāyūnām vā saṃmūrcchanam saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ sa ca samāna vegayoḥ viruddha diś kriyayoḥ sannipātaḥ sa ca tṛṇa tūlaka ādeḥ ūrdhva gamanena anumīyate vāyvoḥ ūrdhva gamanasya sannipātasya ca atīndriya tvāt tṛṇa ādīnām tu pratyakṣāṇām ūrdhva gamana lakṣaṇāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratyakṣāyāḥ sparśavat vegavat dravya abhighāta nodana anyatara janya tvam anumīyate

original: tathāhi tiryyaggamanasvabhāvasya vāyorūrdhvagamanaṃ parasparapratīghātamantareṇānupapadyamānaṃ parasparapratīghātaṃ sādhayati nadīpayaḥpūrayostathādarśanāt tadūrdhvagamanañca tṛṇādyūrdhvagamanānumeyaṃ na hi tṛṇadīnāmūrdhvagamanaṃ sparśavadvegavad‌dravyābhighātanodanānyatarad vineti || 14 ||
analyzed: tathā hi tiryyaggamana svabhāvasya vāyoḥ ūrdhvagamanam paraspara pratīghātam antareṇa anupapadyamānam paraspara pratīghātam sādhayati nadī payaḥpūrayoḥ tathā darśanāt tat ūrdhvagamanam ca tṛṇa ādi ūrdhvagamana anumeyam na hi tṛṇa dīnām ūrdhvagamanam sparśavat vegavat dravya abhighāta nodana anyatarat vinā iti

original: nanvadṛṣṭaliṅgo vāyurityuktaṃ tathā ca kathametadityata āha --
analyzed: nanu adṛṣṭa liṅgaḥ vāyuḥ iti uktam tathā ca katham etat iti atas āha

original: vāyusannikarṣe pratyakṣābhāvād dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ na vidyate || 15 ||
analyzed: vāyu sannikarṣe pratyakṣa abhāvāt dṛṣṭam liṅgam na vidyate

original: dṛṣṭaṃ hi liṅgaṃ yatra pratyakṣeṇa vyāptigrahastaducyate yathā dhūmo'raneḥ| vāyusannikarṣe ca vāyunā sahāvinābhāve pratyakṣaṃ nāsti na hi bhavati yo yaḥ sparśakampādimān sa vāyuriti kasyacit pratyakṣaṃ vāyorevāpratyakṣātvādata eva tādṛśaṃ pratyakṣagṛhītavyāptikaṃ liṅgaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭam hi liṅgam yatra pratyakṣeṇa vyāpti grahaḥ tat ucyate yathā dhūma uraneḥ vāyu sannikarṣe ca vāyunā saha avinābhāve pratyakṣam na asti na hi bhavati yaḥ yaḥ sparśa kampa ādimān sa vāyuḥ iti kasyacid pratyakṣam vāyoḥ eva apratyakṣa atvāt atas eva tādṛśam pratyakṣa gṛhīta vyāptikam liṅgam na asti iti arthaḥ

original: tarhi vāyoranumānameva kathamityata uktameva draḍhayitumāha --

original: nyāyavārttike'pi yat kāraṇabhedena saṃśaye tritvamuktaṃ tadapi na sambhavati vyabhacāreṇa samānadharmādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ kāraṇatvasyaivāsambhavāt| na hi tṛṇāraṇimaṇijanyavahnau vaijātyavadatrāpi vaijātyaṃ kalpanoyaṃ saṃśayatvāvacchinnakāryaṃ prati samānadharmatvenaiva kāraṇatāyāḥ kalpanāt|

original: yacca pradhānavidhikoṭitvapradhānaniṣedhakoṭitvādi vaijātyamuktam, tadananugatatvānnāvacchedakam| tathāca saṃśayo na trividho na vā pañcavidhaḥ kintvekavidha eva, prakārāntareṇa tu dvaividhyaṃ sūtrakṛdeva spaṣṭayati|

original: kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgācca kāryākāryavibhāgo yathā'ṅgulītaruvibhāgāddhastataruvibhāgastataḥ śarīrataruvibhāga iti|

original: nanu vibhāga eva na pramāṇaṃ saṃyogābhāva eva vibhāgavyavahārāditi cenna saṃyogābhāvo'tyantābhāvaścet guṇakarmaṇorapi vibhāgavyavahāraprasaṅgāt| dravyayorvarttamānaḥ saṃyogātyantābhāvo vibhaktapratyayaheturiti cennāvayavāvayavinorapi prasaṅgāt| akāryakāraṇabhūtayordravyayoriti cet vindhyahimavatorapisyāt|

analyzed: bhavati eva tatra iti ced na bhrāntasya guṇa karmaṇoḥ api bhāvāt abhrāntam adhikṛtya vyavahārasya cintyamāna tvāt saṃyoga vināśaḥ vibāgaḥ iti ced ekatara saṃyogi nāśena naṣṭe saṃyoge tad vyahāra prasaṅgāt saṃyoginoḥ vidyamānayoḥ iti ced eka saṃyoga nāśa anantaram punar saṃyuktayoḥ kuvala āmalakayoḥ saṃyoga daśāyām api vibhakta pratyaya prasaṅgāt tatra yāvadartha abhāvāt

original: kiñca yatrāṅgulīhastabhujaśarīrāṇāṃ svasvakarmaṇā tarusaṃyogastatrāṅgulīmātre samutpannena karmaṇā'ṅgulītarusaṃyoganāśasambhave'pi hastatarubhujataruśarīratarusaṃyogānāmanāśaprasaṅgāt hastādīnāmakriyatvāt aṅgulīkarmaṇaśca vyadhikaraṇatvāt| vyadhikaraṇasyāpi karmaṇaḥ saṃyoganāśakatve kvacidapyutpannena karmaṇā yugapadeva sarvasaṃyoganāśāpatteḥ|

original: śabdavibhāgau ca vibhāgakāryau, tatra vibhāgasya śabdāsamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ mṛṣyāmahe, na hi vaṃśe pāṭhyamāne dale ca caraṇayantraṇāvaṣṭavye dalāntarecoparikṛṣyamāṇe yaḥ śabdo jāyate tatra dalākāśavibhāgādanaydasamavāyikāraṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ| na ca davadahanadahyamānasphuṭadveṇucītkāro vibhāgātiriktamasamavāyikāraṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ|

original: kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgācca kāryākāryavibhāgamanumanyāmahe kathamanyathā svasvakarmajanitāṅgulotaruvibhāge sati aṅgulītarusaṃyogānāśe satyapi hastatarusaṃyogādīnāṃ nāśaḥ, tatra hi vibhāgajavibhāgaparamparaiva tattatsaṃyoganāśiketyuktatvāt|

original: kāraṇadvayavibhāgapūrvake tu kāraṇākāraṇavibhāge na saṃpratyaya yato vaṃśadale yadutpannaṃ karma tena dalāntaravibhāgavadākāśādivibāgasyāpi jananasambhavāt yāvadbhiḥ saṃyuktamāsīt tāvadbhastatkarmaṇā vibhāgasya darśanāt, na hyaṅgulyāmutpannena karmaṇā'ṅgulyantaravibhāgavadākāśādideśebhyo'pi vibhāgā na janyante kamaladale cotpannena karmaṇā
analyzed: kāraṇa dvaya vibhāga pūrvake tu kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāge na yatas vaṃśa dale yat utpannam karma tena dala antara vibhāga vat ākāśa ādi vibāgasya api janana sambhavāt yāvadbhiḥ saṃyuktam āsīt tāvadbhaḥ tad karmaṇā vibhāgasya darśanāt na hi aṅgulyām utpannena karmaṇā aṅguli antara vibhāga vat ākāśa ādi deśebhyaḥ api vibhāgāḥ na janyante kamala dale ca utpannena karmaṇā aṅguli antara vibhāga vat ākāśa ādi deśebhyaḥ api vibhāgāḥ na janyant

original: dalāntaravibāgavadākāśādideśebhyo vā na vibhāgā ārabhyante| dravyārambhakasaṃyogāvirodhinaḥ śatamapi vibhāgānekaṃ karmārabhatāṃ tattu karma dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgabhāramate na tat dravyārambhakasaṃyogāvirodhinamapi yacca dravyārambhakasaṃyogāvirodhinaṃ na tad dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinamiti brūmaḥ|
analyzed: dala antara vibāga vat ākāśa ādi deśebhyaḥ vā na vibhāgāḥ ārabhyante dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga avirodhinaḥ śatam api vibhāgān ekam karma ārabhatām tat tu karma dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhinam vibhāga bhāramate na tat dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga avirodhinam api yat ca dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga avirodhinam na tat dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhinam iti brūmaḥ

original: kuta etaditi cet kāryayvaicitryeṇa kāraṇavaicitryasyāvaśyakatvāt| nanu karmaṇi vaicitryamāvaśyakaṃ tathācaikaṃ karma dravyārambhakasayogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgaṃ janayatu yathā vikasatkamalakuḍmalādāvaparañca dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinamavirodhinañcobhayamiti|

original: maivam, kāryyavirodho hi kāraṇavaicitryakalpanāmūlaṃ sa ca virodhaḥ ekasya dravyārambhakasaṃyogapratidvandvitvena, aparasya tu tadapratidvandvitveneti tathaiva vaicitryasyāpi kalpanaucityāt|

original: taccedaṃ vaṃśadale vartamānaṃ karma daladvayavibhāgamātraṃ janayati, sa ca vibhāgo'gre ākāśādideśādvibāgaṃ dravyārambhakasaṃyogāpratidvandvinaṃ vibhāgamārabhate, tasya ca nirapekṣasya vibhāgajanane karmatvāpattiriti dravyanāśaviśiṣṭaṃ kālamapekṣate|

original: so'yaṃ vibhāga uttarasaṃyoganāśyaḥ kṣaṇatrayasthāyo| kvacidāśrayanāśanaśyaḥ, tad yathātantoravayave'śau karma tadanantarasaṃśudvayavibhāgastadaiva tantvantare karma tatoṃ'śudvayavibhāgena tantvārambhakasaṃyoganāśastantukarmaṇā ca vibhāgastato dravyārambhakasaṃyoganāśāttantunāśastannāśācca tantvantarakarmajanyavibhāganāśaḥ|

original: atītatvamanāgatatvaṃ varttamānatvañca dhūmāderyatra na niścitaṃ tatra kathamanumitiriti cet, na kathañcit tatra sādhyasyāpi sandehāt| pūrvāparadinayoḥ sattvaniścaye madhyandine tu sandehe kathamanumitiriti cet taddināvacchinnadhūmādinā taddināvacchinnavahnyāderanumānāt, tathaiva vyāpteḥ kāraṇatvāvadhāraṇāt|

original: asyedaṃ kāryyakāraṇasambandhaścāvayavādbhavati || 2 ||

original: asyedamityetāvadeva prayojakaṃ bhavatīti, asya sādhanasya dhūmāderidaṃ sādhyaṃ vahnyādi| yadvā'sya vahnayāderidaṃ vyāpyaṃ dhūmādi| tathāca vyāpyatvagrahamātraṃ tantraṃ na tu kāryakāraṇabhāvādirapi| nanu pūrvasūtre tarhi parisahkhyānamatantramata āha -- kāryyakāraṇasambandha iti| anena coktaṃ sambandhāntaramapyupalakṣayati|

original: sambandhapade ca viṣayilakṣaṇā, tena sambandha iti sambandhopanyāsa ityarthaḥ| kutastadupanyāsa ityata āha -- avayavāt ekadeśāt udāharaṇamātrāt lyab‌lope pañcamī| tenodāharaṇamanurudhya kāryyakāraṇabhāvādeḥ sambandhasyopanyāsa iha darśane sāṅkhyādidarśane ca bhavatītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: sambandha pade ca viṣayi lakṣaṇā tena sambandhaḥ iti sambandha upanyāsaḥ iti arthaḥ kutas tad upanyāsaḥ iti atas āha avayavāt eka deśāt udāharaṇa mātrāt pañcamī tena udāharaṇam anurudhya kāryya kāraṇa bhāva ādeḥ sambandhasya upanyāsaḥ iha darśane sāṅkhya ādi darśane ca bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: bhaviṣyati kaścidatropādhiritiśaṅkāpiśācī sakalavidhiniṣedhavyavahārānāskandatītyanādeyetyanaupādhikatvaniścayasambhavāt| upādhilakṣaṇaṃ vyāptilakṣaṇaṃ coktam|

original: taccānumānaṃ dvividhaṃ -- svārthaṃ parārthañca| tatra svārthaṃ svayageva vyāptipakṣadharmatayoranusandhānāt| parārthañca parodīritanyāyajanyavyāptipakṣadharmatājñānāt| nyāyaśca tṛtīyaliṅgaparāmarśaprayojakaśabdajñānajanakavākyam| tadavayavāśca pañca| tatrāvayavatvaṃ tṛtīyaliṅgaparāmarśaprayojakaśābdajñānajñanakaśābdajñānajanakavākyatvam|
analyzed: tat ca anumānam dvividham svārtham parārtham ca tatra svārtham svayam eva vyāpti pakṣa dharmatayoḥ anusandhānāt parārtham ca para udīrita nyāya janya vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā jñānāt nyāyaḥ ca tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśa prayojaka śabda jñāna janaka vākyam tad avayavāḥ ca pañca tatra avayava tvam tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśa prayojaka śābda jñāna jñanaka śābda jñāna janaka vākya tvam

original: tāni ca vākyāni pratijñāhetūdāharaṇopanayanigamanāni|

original: tatra pratijñā -- uddeśyānumityanyūnānatiriktaviṣayakaśābdajñānajanakaṃ nyāyāvayavavākyam| hetuśca prakṛtasādhanagatapañcamyanto nyāyāvayavaḥ| udāharaṇantu prakṛtasādhyasādhanāvinābhāvapratipādako nyāyāvayavaḥ| upanayaścāvinābhāvaviśiṣṭasya hetoḥ pakṣavaiśiṣṭyapratipādako nyāyāvayavaḥ|

original: nigamanantu pakṣe prakṛtasādhyavaiśiṣṭyapratipādako nyāyāvayavaḥ| evaṃ ca pravarttate nyāyaśabdo'nityaḥ kṛtakatvāt, yad yat kṛtakaṃ tadanityam, anityatvavyāpyakṛtakatvavāṃścāyam, tasmādanityaḥ|
analyzed: nigamanam tu pakṣe prakṛta sādhya vaiśiṣṭya pratipādakaḥ nyāya avayavaḥ evam ca pravarttate nyāya śabdaḥ nityaḥ kṛtaka tvāt yat yat kṛtakam tat anityam anitya tva vyāpya kṛtaka tvavān ca ayam tasmāt anityaḥ

original: eteṣāmeva pratijñāpadeśanidarśanānusandhānapratyāmnāyā ityanvarthā vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ sajñāḥ| atra ca vādajalpavitaṇḍānāṃ pravṛttiprakāraśchalajātinigrahasthānalakṣaṇāni ca vādivinode'nveṣṭavyāni || 2 ||
analyzed: eteṣām eva pratijñā apadeśa nidarśana anusandhāna pratyāmnāyāḥ iti anvarthāḥ vaiśeṣikāṇām sajñāḥ atra ca vāda jalpa vitaṇḍānām pravṛtti prakāraḥ chala jāti nigrahasthāna lakṣaṇāni ca vādi vinodena veṣṭavyāni

original: pramāṇāntarāṇi laiṅgike'ntarbhāvayituṃ prakaraṇāntaramārabhate --
analyzed: pramāṇa antarāṇi laiṅgike ntar bhāvayitum prakaraṇa antaram ārabhate

original: etena sābdaṃ vyākhyātam || 3 ||
analyzed: etena sa abdam vyākhyātam

original: śābdaṃ śabdakaraṇakaṃ jñānamidamiti yannaiyāyikādīnāmabhimataṃ tadapyetena laiṅgikatvena liṅgaprabhavatvenaiva vyākhyātam| yathā vyāptipakṣadharmatāpratisandhānāpekṣaṃ laiṅgikaṃ tathā śābdamapi| tathāhi ete padārthāḥ mithaḥ saṃsargavantaḥ ākāṅkṣādimadbhiḥ smāritatvāt gāmabhyājeti padārthasārthavat|
analyzed: śābdam śabda karaṇakam jñānam idam iti yat naiyāyika ādīnām abhimatam tat api etena laiṅgika tvena liṅga prabhava tvena eva vyākhyātam yathā vyāpti pakṣa dharmatā pratisandhāna apekṣam laiṅgikam tathā śābdam api tathā hi ete padārthāḥ mithas saṃsargavantaḥ ākāṅkṣā ādimadbhiḥ smārita tvāt gām abhyāja iti padārtha sārtha vat

original: tatra hi ākāṅkṣādimat‌tpadakadambamāristatvaṃ padārthānāṃ mithaḥ saṃsargavattvavyāpyaṃ gṛhītvaiva saṃsargavattvamanuminoti kiṃ kalpanīyapramāṇabhūvena śabdena|
analyzed: tatra hi padārthānām mithas saṃsargavat tva vyāpyam gṛhītvā eva saṃsargavat tvam anuminoti kim kalpanīya pramāṇa bhūvena śabdena

original: nanu nadītīre paṃca phalāni santītyanāptavākye vyabhicārānnedamanumānamiti cenna, āptoktatvenāpi viśeṣaṇāt, āptatvaṃ hi prakṛtavākyārthagocarayathārthavākyārthajñānavattvaṃ na tvapratārakatvamātram, tacca vākyārthapratīteḥ pūrvaṃ durgrahamiti cenna, śabdaprāmāṇyavādibhirapi vyabhicāriśabdavyāvarttakasyāptoktatvasya grāhyatvenābhimatatvāt|
analyzed: nanu nadī tīre paṃca phalāni santi iti anāpta vākye vyabhicārāt na idam anumānam iti ced na āpta uktatvena api viśeṣaṇāt āpta tvam hi prakṛta vākya artha gocara yathārtha vākya artha jñānavat tvam na tu apratāraka tva mātram tat ca vākya artha pratīteḥ pūrvam durgraham iti ced na śabda prāmāṇya vādibhiḥ api vyabhicāri śabda vyāvarttakasya āpta uktatvasya grāhya tvena abhimata tvāt

original: teṣāṃ prāmāṇyagrahaṇārthaṃ tadapekṣā, śābdantu jñānaṃ tad‌grahamanatreṇāpyupapadyate, tava tu yādṛśaṃ liṅgaṃ tādṛśagrahaṇamāvaśyakam, vyāpyantvāptoktatvaviśiṣṭamiti cenna, ayamatrābhrānta iti sāmānyato grahaṇasambhavāt|
analyzed: teṣām prāmāṇya grahaṇa artham tad apekṣā śābdam tu jñānam tad graham anatreṇa api upapadyate tava tu yādṛśam liṅgam tādṛśa grahaṇam āvaśyakam vyāpyantu āpta ukta tva viśiṣṭam iti ced na ayam atra abhrāntaḥ iti sāmānyatas grahaṇa sambhavāt

original: nanvatreti prakṛtasaṃsarge ityeva paryyavasyati tathāca pūrvamaśakyameva tad‌grahaṇamiti cenna, prakaraṇasamabhivyāhārādimāhātmyāt sāmānyata āptatvaniścayasambhavena liṅganiścayasambhavāt, kadācittatra visaṃvāde'pi vāṣpādau dhūmadharmeṇevānumānapravṛtteḥ|
analyzed: nanu atra iti prakṛta saṃsarge iti eva paryyavasyati tathā ca pūrvam aśakyam eva tad grahaṇam iti ced na prakaraṇa samabhivyāhāra ādi māhātmyāt sāmānyatas āpta tva niścaya sambhavena liṅga niścaya sambhavāt kadācid tatra visaṃvāde api vāṣpa ādau dhūma dharmeṇa iva anumāna pravṛtteḥ

original: nanvete padārthāḥ saṃsṛṣṭā eveti vā sādhyam sambhāvitasaṃsargā iti vā? nādyaḥ, anāptokte vyabhicārāt, na dvitīyaḥ, yogyatāmātrasiddhāvapi saṃsargāniścayānniṣkampapravṛttyanupapatteḥ, yogyatāyāśca pūrvameva hetuviśeṣaṇatvena jñātatvāt kimanumāneneti cenna, niyamasyaiva sādhyatvāt āptoktatvena viśeṣaṇācca na vyabhicāra ityuktatvāt|
analyzed: nanu ete padārthāḥ saṃsṛṣṭāḥ eva iti vā sādhyam sambhāvita saṃsargāḥ iti vā na ādyaḥ anāpta ukte vyabhicārāt na dvitīyaḥ yogyatā mātra siddhau api saṃsarga aniścayāt niṣkampa pravṛtti anupapatteḥ yogyatāyāḥ ca pūrvam eva hetu viśeṣaṇa tvena jñāta tvāt kim anumānena iti ced na niyamasya eva sādhya tvāt āpta ukta tvena viśeṣaṇāt ca na vyabhicāraḥ iti ukta tvāt

original: nanvākāṅkṣā śrotari tadutpādyasaṃsargāvagamaprāgabhāvaḥ, sa ca svarūpasanneva hetustaj‌jñāne ca saṃsargajñānasya pūrvameva bhāvādanumānavaiyarthyamiti cenna, na hi saṃsargāvagamaprāgabhāvamātramākāṅkṣāṃ brūmaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? smāritatadākṣiptāvinābhāvaviśiṣṭam, tathā ca viśeṣaṇāṃśajñānādevākāṅkṣāyā jñānāt|
analyzed: nanu ākāṅkṣā śrotari tad utpādya saṃsarga avagama prāgabhāvaḥ sa ca svarūpa sannā iva hetuḥ tad jñāne ca saṃsarga jñānasya pūrvam eva bhāvāt anumāna vaiyarthyam iti ced na hi saṃsarga avagama prāgabhāva mātram ākāṅkṣām brūmaḥ kim tarhi smārita tad ākṣipta avinābhāva viśiṣṭam tathā ca viśeṣaṇa aṃśa jñānāt eva ākāṅkṣāyāḥ jñānāt

original: tarhi tāvadevākāṅkṣā'stviti cenna, vimala jalaṃ nadyāḥ kacche mahiṣaścaratītyatrāpi nadīkacchayoravinābhāvasattvenānvayabodhāpatteḥ, nīlamutpalamityatra nīlotpalayoravinābhāvābhāve'pi tadākṣiptayordravyaguṇayoravinābāvasambhavāt|
analyzed: tarhi tāvat eva ākāṅkṣā astu iti ced na vimala jalam nadyāḥ kacche mahiṣaḥ carati iti atra api nadī kacchayoḥ avinābhāva sattvena anvaya bodha āpatteḥ nīlam utpalam iti atra nīla utpalayoḥ avinābhāva abhāve pi tad ākṣiptayoḥ dravya guṇayoḥ avinābāva sambhavāt

original: yadvā padasmāritagocarā jijñāsaivākāṅakṣā abhidhānāparyyavasānaṃ vā| tathāpi taj‌jñānamāvaśyakaṃ jñāyamānakāraṇe jñānopayuktavyabhicārivailakṣaṇyāt vyāptavat|
analyzed: yat vā pada smārita gocarā jijñāsā eva ākāṅakṣā abhidhāna aparyyavasānam vā tathā api tad jñānam āvaśyakam jñāyamāna kāraṇe jñāna upayukta vyabhicāri vailakṣaṇyāt vyāpta vat

original: ata evānanvayaniścayaviraho vā, bādhakapramāṇābhāvo vā, sajātīye darśanaṃ vā, itarapadārthasaṃsarge'parapadārthaniṣṭhātyantābhāvāpratiyogitvapramāviśeṣyatvaṃ vā yogyatā'stu, taj‌jñānamāvaśyakam| āsatterapyavyavadhānena smaraṇarūpāyā jñānaṃ tantram| saṃsarge ca saṃsṛjyamānaviśeṣādeva viśeṣa iti nānabhimataviśeṣasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: atas eva ananvaya niścaya virahaḥ vā bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ vā sajātīye darśanam vā itara padārtha saṃsarga ipara padārtha niṣṭha atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tva pramā viśeṣya tvam vā yogyatā astu tad jñānam āvaśyakam āsatteḥ api avyavadhānena smaraṇa rūpāyāḥ jñānam tantram saṃsarge ca saṃsṛjyamāna viśeṣāt eva viśeṣaḥ iti na anabhimata viśeṣa siddhiḥ

original: yadvā etāni padāni smāritārthasaṃsargajñānapūrvakāṇi ākāṅkṣāyomyatāsattimatpadakadamvatvāt gāmabhyājeti padakadambavadityanumānāt jñānāvacchedakatayā'bimataviśeṣasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: yat vā etāni padāni smārita artha saṃsarga jñāna pūrvakāṇi ākāṅkṣā yomya tā āsattimat pada kadamva tvāt gām abhyājeti pada kadamba vat iti anumānāt jñāna avacchedaka tayā a bimata viśeṣa siddhiḥ

original: yattu etāni padāni smāritārthasaṃsargavantīti sādhyam, tat padānāṃ padārthasaṃsargavattvaṃ bādhitamityupekṣaṇīyam| na ca liṅgatayā saṃsargajñāpakatvameva padānāṃ saṃsargavattvam, tasyānumānāt pūrvamasiddhatvena vyāpteragrahāt|
analyzed: yat tu etāni padāni smārita artha saṃsargavanti iti sādhyam tat padānām padārtha saṃsargavat tvam bādhitam iti upekṣaṇīyam na ca liṅgatayā saṃsarga jñāpaka tvam eva padānām saṃsargavat tvam tasya anumānāt pūrvam asiddha tvena vyāpteḥ agrahāt

original: kecicceṣṭā pramāṇāntarāmiti vadanti|
analyzed: kecid ceṣṭā pramāṇa antarām iti vadanti

original: tatrocyate -- ceṣṭā dvividhā kṛtasamayā'kṛtasamayā ca| tatra kṛtasamayā abhiprāyasthaṃ śabdaṃ smārayati na tu saṃsargapramāmapi janayati lipivat, smṛtyārūḍhaḥ śabda eva tatra pramāṇaṃ śabdasya ca liṅgatvamuktam| na ca śabdasmaraṇaṃ ceṣṭāyā avāntaravyāpāraḥ, ceṣṭāmantareṇāpi śabdārthapratyayāt vyāpāratve tu ceṣṭānaiyatyāpatteḥ|
analyzed: tatra ucyate ceṣṭā dvividhā kṛta samayā akṛta samayā ca tatra kṛta samayā abhiprāya stham śabdam smārayati na tu saṃsarga pramām api janayati lipi vat smṛti ārūḍhaḥ śabdaḥ eva tatra pramāṇam śabdasya ca liṅga tvam uktam na ca śabda smaraṇam ceṣṭāyāḥ avāntara vyāpāraḥ ceṣṭām antareṇa api śabda artha pratyayāt vyāpāra tve tu ceṣṭā naiyatya āpatteḥ

original: nanvevaṃ kathameḍamūkasya ceṣṭādhīno vyavahāraḥ? tasya tatrasamayagrahābhāvāditi cenna, tasya ceṣṭātaḥ kathamarthe'pi saṃpratyaya iti cintanīyatvāt tasyārthe'pi saṅgatigrahābhāvāt| vyavahārastu tasyāvinābhāvagrahāt karituragayoriva kaśāṅkuśābhighātāttattadvyavahārapāṭavopapatteḥ|
analyzed: nanu evam katham eḍamūkasya ceṣṭā adhīnaḥ vyavahāraḥ tasya tatra samaya graha abhāvāt iti ced na tasya ceṣṭātaḥ katham arthe api saṃpratyayaḥ iti cintanīya tvāt tasya arthe api saṅgati graha abhāvāt vyavahāraḥ tu tasya avinābhāva grahāt kari turagayoḥ iva kaśā aṅkuśa abhighātāt tad tad vyavahāra pāṭava upapatteḥ

original: akṛtasamayā tu yā kṛtyānvayinī sā prayojakābhiprāyaṃ smārayantī prayojyaṃ pravarttayati, na tu kutracit pramāṃ janayati| yathā śaṅkhadhvanau tvayā gantavyamiti śrutaśaṅkhadhvaniḥ pratiṣṭhate, tatā yadā mayā tarjanyūrdhvīkriyate tadā tvayā'sau tāḍanīya iti tadā tāḍayati, na tu kiñcit pramiṇoti|
analyzed: akṛta samayā tu yā kṛtyā anvayinī sā prayojaka abhiprāyam smārayantī prayojyam pravarttayati na tu kutracid pramām janayati yathā śaṅkha dhvanau tvayā gantavyam iti śruta śaṅkha dhvaniḥ pratiṣṭhate yadā mayā tarjanī ūrdhvīkriyate tadā tvayā asau tāḍanīyaḥ iti tadā tāḍayati na tu kiñcid pramiṇoti

original: jñaptyanvayinī tvakṛtasamayā yathādaśānāmaṅgulīnāmūrdhvakaraṇena daśa saṅkhyā mudrāṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ vā tvayā jñātavyeti -- kārakapradhānā| hastākuñcanadarśanāttvayā samāgantavyamiti kriyāpradhānā|
analyzed: jñapti anvayinī tu a kṛta samayā yathā daśānām aṅgulīnām ūrdhvakaraṇena daśa saṅkhyāḥ mudrāṇām purāṇānām vā tvayā jñātavyā iti kāraka pradhānā hasta ākuñcana darśanāt tvayā samāgantavyam iti kriyā pradhānā

original: tathācānayā ceṣṭayā padārthā eva svatantrāḥ paraṃ smāryyante na tu teṣāṃ parasparamanvayo'pi bodhyate, tad‌bodhakakartṛkarmādivibhaktivat prakṛte ceṣṭaikadeśānāṃ niyatānāmabhāvāt| tarhi saṃsargabodhamantareṇa ceṣṭātaḥ kathaṃ pravṛttinivṛttī iti cet saṃśayapratibhayoranyatarasmāditi gṛhāṇa| tasmānna ceṣṭā'pi pramāṇamitiṃ || 3 ||
analyzed: tathā ca anayā ceṣṭayā padārthāḥ eva svatantrāḥ param smāryyante na tu teṣām parasparam anvayaḥ api bodhyate tad bodhaka kartṛ karma ādi vibhakti vat prakṛte ceṣṭā eka deśānām niyatānām abhāvāt tarhi saṃsarga bodham antareṇa ceṣṭātaḥ katham pravṛtti nivṛttī iti ced saṃśaya pratibhayoḥ anyatarasmāt iti gṛhāṇa tasmāt na ceṣṭā api pramāṇam itiṃ

original: nanu śabdaḥ kathaṃ liṅgaṃ śabdasyāpadeśasvabhāvatvena liṅgabhinnatvādityāśaṅkyāha --
analyzed: nanu śabdaḥ katham liṅgam śabdasya apadeśa svabhāva tvena liṅga bhinna tvāt iti āśaṅkya āha

original: heturapadeśo liṅgaṃ pramāṇaṃ karaṇamityanarthāntaram || 4 ||
analyzed: hetuḥ apadeśaḥ liṅgam pramāṇam karaṇam iti anarthāntaram

original: apadiśyate kathyate'nenārtha ityapadeśaḥ śabdaḥ, sa ca hetuliṅgaparyyāya eva pramāṇamiti| liṅgavidhayā pramākaraṇamityarthaḥ| evaṃ karaṇaśabdo'pi laiṅgikajñānakaraṇe liṅga eva varttate| dvayī karaṇagatiḥ, kiñcit sannikarpādhīnapravṛtti kiñciccāvinābhāvabalapravṛtti| śabdasya tu arthena na sannikarṣo nāpyavinābhāva iti kathamarthaṃ gamayet|
analyzed: apadiśyate kathyate inā arthaḥ iti apadeśaḥ śabdaḥ sa ca hetu liṅga paryyāyaḥ eva pramāṇam iti liṅga vidhayā pramā karaṇam iti arthaḥ evam karaṇa śabdaḥ api laiṅgika jñāna karaṇe liṅge eva varttate dvayī karaṇa gatiḥ kiñcid sannikarpa adhīna pravṛtti kiñcid ca avinābhāva bala pravṛtti śabdasya tu arthena na sannikarṣaḥ na api avinābhāvaḥ iti katham artham gamayet

original: saṅketād gamayatīti cet saṅketo hi padārthe na tu tatsaṃsarge| tatrāpi saṅketa iti cenna, tasyānekavidhatvena saṅketaviṣayabhāvānupapatteḥ| padārthasaṅketabalādeva vākyārtho'pi bhāsate iti cenna, anyasaṅketenānyopasthitāvatiprasaṅgāt, śabdasmāritasaṃsargatvena niyama iti cet tathācaitanniyamabalenānumānasyaiva labdhāvasaratvāt|
analyzed: saṅketāt gamayati iti ced saṅketaḥ hi padārthe na tu tad saṃsarge tatra api saṅketaḥ iti ced na tasya anekavidha tvena saṅketa viṣaya bhāva anupapatteḥ padārtha saṅketa balāt eva vākya arthaḥ api bhāsate iti ced na anya saṅketena anya upasthitau atiprasaṅgāt śabda smārita saṃsarga tvena niyamaḥ iti ced tathā ca etad niyama balena anumānasya eva labdha avasara tvāt

original: saṅketasyāpi icchāmātratvenāti prasaktatvāt| īśvarecchā nātiprasakteti cenna, tadicchāmantareṇāpi gaṅgādipadāttīrādyupasthiterityalaṃ naiyāyikeṣu dhṛṣṭatayeti || 4 ||
analyzed: saṅketasya api icchā mātra tvena ati prasakta tvāt īśvara icchā na ati prasaktā iti ced na tad icchām antareṇa api gaṅgā ādi padāt tīra ādi upasthiteḥ iti alam naiyāyikeṣu dhṛṣṭa tayā iti

original: upamānādīnāmapi parābhimatānām avinābhāvabalapravṛttikānāṃ laiṅgika evāntarbhāva iti pratipādayitumāha --
analyzed: upamāna ādīnām api para abhimatānām avinābhāva bala pravṛttikānām laiṅgikaḥ eva antarbhāvaḥ iti pratipādayitum āha

original: asyedamiti buddhyapekṣitatvāt || 5 ||
analyzed: asya idam iti buddhi apekṣita tvāt

original: upamānārthāpattisambhavābhāvānāmiti śeṣaḥ| asya vyāpakasya idaṃ vyāpyamityākārā yā buddhiḥ sā janakatvenāpekṣitā yeṣāṃ te tadapekṣitāstasya bhāvastadapekṣitatvaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ| āhitāgnipāṭhāt ktāntena bahuvrīhiḥ, tārakādipāṭhādito vā ||
analyzed: upamāna artha āpatti sambhava abhāvānām iti śeṣaḥ asya vyāpakasya idam vyāpyam iti ākārā yā buddhiḥ sā janaka tvena apekṣitā yeṣām te tad apekṣitāḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tad apekṣita tvam tasmāt iti arthaḥ āhitāgni pāṭhāt kta antena bahuvrīhiḥ tārakā ādi pāṭhāt itas vā

original: tatropamānaṃ tāvadanumānameva śabdadvārā| tathāhi gosadṛśo gavaya iti vākyantāvat āraṇyakena kīdṛk gavaya iti nāgarikajijñāsāyāmabhidhīyate tatra yo gosadṛśaḥ sa gavayaśabdavācya iti sāmānādhikaraṇyabalāt atideśavākyaśravaṇānantarameva paricchinatti, vanaṃ gatastu tādṛśa piṇḍamupalabhyāyamasau gavayaśabdavācya iti pratisandhatte|
analyzed: tatra upamānam tāvat anumānam eva śabda dvārā tathā hi go sadṛśaḥ gavayaḥ iti vākyantāvat āraṇyakena kīdṛś gavayaḥ iti nāgarika jijñāsāyām abhidhīyate tatra yaḥ go sadṛśaḥ sa gavaya śabda vācyaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇya balāt atideśa vākya śravaṇa anantaram eva paricchinatti vanam gataḥ tu piṇḍam upalabhya ayam asau gavaya śabda vācyaḥ iti pratisandhatte

original: atideśavākyaśravaṇasamaye gavayatvaṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ na jñātamataḥ kathaṃ saṃjñāpariccheda iti cet lakṣaṇayā tatpratītisambhavāt|
analyzed: atideśa vākya śravaṇa samaye gavaya tvam pravṛtti nimittam na jñātam atas katham saṃjñā paricchedaḥ iti ced lakṣaṇayā tad pratīti sambhavāt

original: gosadṛśo gavaya iti vākye'nvayānupapattivirahāt kathaṃ lakṣaṇeti cet tātparyyānupapatteḥ sattvāt, na hi vyutpitsuṃ prati gosādṛśyasya sakhaṇḍasya pravṛttinimittatvenopadarśanamanucitaṃ tasmādakhaṇḍajātiviśeṣe tātparyamasyeti lakṣaṇāmambhavāt|
analyzed: go sadṛśaḥ gavayaḥ iti katham lakṣaṇā iti ced tātparyya anupapatteḥ sattvāt na hi vyutpitsum prati go sādṛśyasya sakhaṇḍasya pravṛtti nimitta tvena upadarśanam anucitam tasmāt akhaṇḍa jāti viśeṣe tātparyam asya iti lakṣaṇā sambhavāt

original: yadvā gavayaśabdo gavayavācakaḥ asati vṛttyantare śiṣṭaistatra prayujyamānatvāt, asati vṛttyantare yaḥ śabdo yatra śiṣṭeḥ prayujyate sa tasya vācako yathā gośabdo gorityanumānādeva gavayasaṃjñāṃ paricchinatti|
analyzed: yat vā gavaya śabdaḥ gavaya vācakaḥ asati vṛtti antare śiṣṭaiḥ tatra prayujyamāna tvāt asati vṛtti antare yaḥ śabdaḥ yatra śiṣṭeḥ prayujyate sa tasya vācakaḥ yathā go śabdaḥ goḥ iti anumānāt eva gavaya saṃjñām paricchinatti

original: tarkaśca yastvayopamānasahakārī vācyaḥ sa varamanumāne klṛptapramāṇabhāve'stu kiṃ kalpanīyapramāṇabhāvenopamāneneti, anumānamayūkhe vistaro'trānveṣṭavyaḥ|
analyzed: tarkaḥ ca yaḥ tvayā upamāna sahakārī vācyaḥ sa varam anumāne klṛpta pramāṇa bhāveḥ tu kim kalpanīya pramāṇa bhāvena upamānena iti anumānamayūkhe vistaraḥ utra anveṣṭavyaḥ

original: arthāpattirapyanumānameva| tathāhi dṛṣṭāthaṣittistāvajjovataścaitrasya gṛhāsattvena dṛḍhatarapramāṇāvadhṛtena bahiḥsattvaṃ kalpayati| tatropapādyopapādakayorvyāpyavyāpakabhāvāvadhāraṇādhīnaiva bahiḥsattvapratītiḥ, bhavati hi jīvato gṛhīsattvaṃ bahiḥsattvena sahacaritaṃ, bahiḥsattvaṃ vinā jīvato gṛhāsattvamanupapannamiti vā jñānam|
analyzed: arthāpattiḥ api anumānam eva tathā hi dṛṣṭā athaṣittiḥ tāvat jovataḥ caitrasya gṛha asattvena dṛḍhatara pramāṇa avadhṛtena bahis sattvam kalpayati tatra upapādya upapādakayoḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva avadhāraṇa adhīnā eva bahis sattva pratītiḥ bhavati hi jīvataḥ gṛha asattvam bahis sattvena sahacaritam bahis sattvam vinā jīvataḥ gṛha asattvam anupapannam iti vā jñānam

original: tatrādye'nvayavyāptirevāntye tu vyatirkavyāptereva graha iti| vyāptirasti na tasya grahaṇamihopayujyate iti cet vyāptigrahamantareṇārthāpattyābhāsānavakāśāt, svarūpasatyā vyāptyā vastuto yadupapādakaṃ tasyaiva kalpanā syāditi dik| saṃśayakaraṇikāyā virodhakaraṇikāyāścānumānāntarbhāva ūhanīyaḥ|
analyzed: tatra ādye nvaya vyāptiḥ eva antye tu vyatirka vyāpteḥ eva grahaḥ iti vyāptiḥ asti na tasya grahaṇam iha upayujyate iti ced vyāpti graham antareṇa arthāpatti ābhāsa anavakāśāt svarūpa satyāḥ vyāptyāḥ vastutas yat upapādakam tasya eva kalpanā syāt iti diś saṃśaya karaṇikāyāḥ virodha karaṇikāyāḥ ca anumāna antarbhāvaḥ ūhanīyaḥ

original: virodhasyāpi sahānavasthānaniyamalakṣaṇasya vyāptighaṭitatvāt| śrutārthāpattirapyanumitānumānaṃ pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅkte ityanena vākyena pīnatvamanumitaṃ tena ca pīnatvena rātribhojanānumānam -- devadatto rātrau bhuṅkte divā'bhojitve sati pīnatvāsambhavāditi|
analyzed: virodhasya api saha anavasthāna niyama lakṣaṇasya vyāpti ghaṭita tvāt śruta arthāpattiḥ api anumita anumānam pīnaḥ devadattaḥ divā na bhuṅkte iti anena vākyena pīna tvam anumitam tena ca pīna tvena rātri bhojana anumānam devadattaḥ rātrau bhuṅkte divābhoji tve sati pīna tva asambhavāt iti

original: sambhavo'pyanumānameva, tadudāharaṇaṃ hi -- sambhavati khāryyāṃ droṇaḥ sambhavati droṇe āḍhakam sambhavati sahasre śatamityādi tatreyaṃ khārī droṇavatī taddhaṭitatvāt yadyena ghaṭitaṃ tattena tadvat, yathā'vayavavān ghaṭaḥ| evamanyadapyūhyam|
analyzed: sambhavaḥ upi anumānam eva tad udāharaṇam hi sambhavati khāryyām droṇaḥ sambhavati droṇe āḍhakam sambhavati sahasre śatam ityādi tatra iyam khārī droṇavatī tad haṭita tvāt yat yena ghaṭitam tat tena tadvat yathā avayavavān ghaṭaḥ evam anyat api ūhyam

original: yattu sambhavati brāhmaṇe vidyā -- sambhavati kṣatriye śauryyamityādi, tatpramāṇameva na bhavati aniścāyakatvāt|
analyzed: yat tu sambhavati brāhmaṇe vidyā sambhavati kṣatriye śauryyam ityādi tat pramāṇam eva na bhavati aniścāyaka tvāt

original: abhāvo'pi na mānāntaraṃ kāryyeṇa kāraṇānumānavat kāryyābhāvena kāraṇābhāvānumānasya vyāptimūlakatvenānumāna evāntarbhavāt|
analyzed: abhāvaḥ api na māna antaram kāryyeṇa kāraṇa anumāna vat kāryya abhāvena kāraṇa abhāva anumānasya vyāpti mūlaka tvena anumāne eva antarbhavāt

original: bhaṭṭamate tu bhūtalādāvabhāvagrāhakaṃ pramāṇamanupalambhākhyam| yat kvacit pratyakṣe kvaciccānumāne'ntarbhūtaṃ cakṣurādinaivābhāvagrahāt| na cendriyamadhikaraṇagraha evopakṣīṇam, abhāvagrahaparyyantaṃ tadvyāpārasattvāt|
analyzed: bhaṭṭa mate tu bhū tala ādau abhāva grāhakam pramāṇam anupalambha ākhyam yat kvacid pratyakṣe kvacid ca anumāne ntarbhūtam cakṣuḥ ādinā eva abhāva grahāt na ca indriyam adhikaraṇa grahe eva upakṣīṇam abhāva graha paryyantam tad vyāpāra sattvāt

original: aitihyamavijñātapravaktṛkaṃ pravādapāramparyyam| iti heti nipātasamudāyaḥ purāvṛtte varttate, tasya bhāva etihyam| tat yadi bādhitārthaṃ na bhavati tadā śabdāntarniveśādanumānam| yadiha vaṭe yakṣo madhūkatarau gaurītyādi, tad yadyāptoktaṃ tadā pūrvavat| nāptoktcettadā na pramāṇam| tadevaṃ pratyakṣamanumānañceti siddhaṃ dvayameva pramāṇamiti || 5 ||
analyzed: aitihyam avijñāta pravaktṛkam pravāda pāramparyyam iti ha iti nipāta samudāyaḥ purāvṛtte varttate tasya bhāvaḥ etihyam tat yadi bādhita artham na bhavati tadā śabda antar niveśāt anumānam yat iha vaṭe yakṣaḥ madhūka tarau gaurī ityādi tat yadi āpta uktam tadā pūrvavat na āpta uktam ced tadā na pramāṇam tat evam pratyakṣam anumānam ca iti siddham dvayam eva pramāṇam iti

original: laiṅgikaṃ vyākhyāya idānīṃ prakaraṇāntaramārabhate --
analyzed: laiṅgikam vyākhyāya idānīm prakaraṇa antaram ārabhate

original: ātmamanasoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣāt saṃskārācca smṛtiḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: ātma manasoḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt saṃskārāt ca smṛtiḥ

original: utpadyata iti śeṣaḥ| saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ praṇidhānādisannidhānam| etasmādasamavāyikāraṇādātmani samavāyini smṛtirvidyāviśeṣa utpadyate| nimittakāraṇamāha -- saṃskārāditi| cakāreṇa vyāpārī pūrvānubhavaḥ samuccīyate| anubhavayāthārthyāyāthārthyamiyamanuvidhatte, rajjuṃ bhujaṅgatayopalabhya palāyitasya tathaiva smṛteḥ|
analyzed: utpadyate iti śeṣaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ praṇidhāna ādi sannidhānam etasmāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt ātmani samavāyini smṛtiḥ vidyā viśeṣaḥ utpadyate nimitta kāraṇam āha saṃskārāt iti cakāreṇa vyāpārī pūrva anubhavaḥ samuccīyate anubhava yāthārthya ayāthārthyam iyam anuvidhatte rajjum bhujaṅga tayā upalabhya palāyitasya tathā eva smṛteḥ

original: na ca satataṃ smṛtiprasaṅgaḥ, saṃskārod‌bodhādhīnatvāt taduktaṃ praśastadevapādaiḥ -- "liṅgadarśanecchānusmaraṇādyapekṣādātmamanasoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣāt paṭ‌vabhyāsādarapratyayajanitācca saṃskārād‌dṛṣṭa śrutānubhūteṣu śeṣānuvyavasāyasmaraṇecchādveṣaheturatītaviṣayā smṛtiḥ" iti|
analyzed: na ca satatam smṛti prasaṅgaḥ saṃskāra udbodha adhīna tvāt tat uktam praśastadeva pādaiḥ liṅga darśana icchā anusmaraṇa ādi apekṣāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt paṭu abhyāsa ādara pratyaya janitāt ca saṃskārāt dṛṣṭa śruta anubhūteṣu śeṣa anuvyavasāya smaraṇa icchā dveṣa hetuḥ atīta viṣayā smṛtiḥ iti

original: ārṣaṃ jñānaṃ sūtarkṛtā pṛthaṅ na lakṣitaṃ yogipratyāntarbhāvitam| padārthapradeśākhye tu prakaraṇe taduktaṃ tadyathā -- "āmnāyavidhātṝṇāmṛṣīṇāmatītānāgatavarttamāneṣvatīndriyeṣvartheṣu dharmādiṣu granthopanibaddheṣu liṅgādyanapekṣādātmamanasoḥ saṃyogāddharmaviśeṣācca prātibhaṃ jñānaṃ yadutpadyate tadārṣam" iti|
analyzed: ārṣam jñānam sūta ṛkṛtā pṛthak na lakṣitam yogi pratyāntar bhāvitam padārtha pradeśa ākhye tu prakaraṇe tat uktam tat yathā āmnāya vidhātṝṇām ṛṣīṇām atīta anāgata varttamāneṣu atīndriyeṣu artheṣu dharma ādiṣu grantha upanibaddheṣu liṅga ādi anapekṣāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt dharma viśeṣāt ca prātibham jñānam yat utpadyate tat ārṣam iti

analyzed: yathā ātma manasoḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt saṃskārāt ca smṛtiḥ tathā svapna jñānam api iti arthaḥ uparata indriya grāmasya pralīna manaskasya yat anubhavanam mānasam tat svapna jñānam

analyzed: tat ca trividham kiñcid saṃskāra pāṭavāt kāmī kruddhaḥ vā yam artham ādṛtaḥ cintayan svapiti tasya tasyām avasthāyām pratyakṣa ākāram jñānam purāṇa ādi śravaṇa janita saṃskāra vaśāt jāyate karṇārjunīyam yuddham idam iti ākāram kiñcid dhātūnām vāta pitta śleṣmaṇām doṣāt tatra vāta doṣāt ākāśa gamanaḥ vasundharā paryyaṭana vyāgra ādi bhaya palāyana ādīni paśyati

original: adṛṣṭavaśādapi tajjanmānubhūteṣu janmāntarānubhūte vā siddhoplutāntaḥkaraṇasya yaj‌jñānamutpadyate, tatra śubhāvedakaṃ dharmāt gajārohaṇaparvatārohaṇachatralābhapāyasabhakṣaṇarājasandarśanādiviṣayakam| adharmāttu tailābhyañjanāndhakūpapatanoṣṭrārohaṇapaṅkamajjanasvavivāhadarśanādiviṣayakaṃ svapnajñānamutpadyate|

original: bhedakāntaramāha -- virodhāt sahānavasthānalakṣaṇāt na hyekasminnātmanyekadā sukhaduḥkhayoranubhavaḥ| cakārādanayoḥ kāryyabhede bhedakaṃ samuccinoti| tathāhi -- anugrahābhiṣvaṅganayanaprasādādi sukhasya, dainyamukhamālinyādi duḥkhasya kāryyamiti tato'pyanayorbhedaḥ.
analyzed: bhedaka antaram āha virodhāt saha anavasthāna lakṣaṇāt na hi ekasmin ātmani ekadā sukha duḥkhayoḥ anubhavaḥ cakārāt anayoḥ kāryya bhede bhedakam samuccinoti tathā hi anugraha abhiṣvaṅga nayana prasāda ādi sukhasya dainya mukha mālinī ādi duḥkhasya kāryyam iti tatas api anayoḥ bhedaḥ

original: taduktaṃ praśastācāryyaiḥ -- "anugrahalakṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ sragādyabhipretaviṣayasānnidhye sati iṣṭotpannadhīndriyārthasannikarṣāddharmādyapekṣādātmanasoḥ saṃyogād yadanugrahābhiṣvaṅganayanādipramodajanakamutpadyate tat sukham" iti| tadidamatīteṣu srak‌candanādiṣu smṛtijamanāgateṣu saṅkalpajam|
analyzed: tat uktam praśasta ācāryyaiḥ anugraha lakṣaṇam sukham sraj ādi abhipreta viṣaya sānnidhye sati iṣṭa utpanna dhī indriya artha sannikarṣāt dharma ādi apekṣāt ātma nasoḥ saṃyogāt yat anugraha abhiṣvaṅga nayana ādi pramoda janakam utpadyate tat sukham iti tat idam atīteṣu srak candana ādiṣu smṛti jam anāgateṣu saṅkalpa jam
